AI.practical_contributions: 为期刊和出版社提供了具体的AI使用声明模板，帮助维护学术出版的质量和可信度

title: Transparency as a Tool of Investor Protection in High-Accountability Investment Portfolios

detail.title: Transparency as a Tool of Investor Protection in High-Accountability Investment Portfolios
detail.abstract: Transparency protects investors by reducing information asymmetry, strengthening fiduciary monitoring, and improving the pricing of risk. Yet in high-accountability investment portfolios, transparency is often treated as a reporting output rather than a governance operating system. This paper synthesizes research on disclosure, agency costs, and information risk to explain how transparency changes investor outcomes and why disclosure volume can fail to produce decision-useful clarity. Using a structured literature review and a governance-to-reporting mapping method, the paper identifies five transparency mechanisms: comparability, verifiability, timeliness, usability, and accountability response. Results are summarized in an integrated framework that links each mechanism to expected effects on liquidity, cost of capital, and fraud or misstatement risk. The paper proposes a layered transparency model for high-accountability portfolios that combines standardized classification, narrative drivers, structured data, and escalation protocols aligned to internal control frameworks such as COSO. The analysis concludes that investor protection improves when transparency is designed to enable replicable oversight across entities and reporting cycles, supported by credible assurance and remediation pathways.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了透明度在高问责投资组合中的作用，指出透明度不应仅是报告输出，而应是治理操作系统。通过文献综述和治理-报告映射方法，识别了五个透明度机制，并提出了分层透明度模型，强调透明度设计应支持可复制的监督和可信的保证。
AI.research_question: 透明度如何影响投资者结果？为什么披露量可能无法产生对决策有用的清晰度？如何设计透明度以在高问责投资组合中改善投资者保护？
AI.motivation: 透明度通常被视为报告输出而非治理操作系统，在高问责投资组合中，披露量可能无法转化为有效的投资者保护，需要理解透明度机制如何真正影响投资者结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息披露理论、代理成本理论和信息风险理论，构建透明度影响投资者结果的综合框架。
AI.method: 采用结构化文献综述和治理-报告映射方法，分析透明度机制及其对投资者结果的影响。
AI.findings: 识别了五个关键透明度机制：可比性、可验证性、及时性、可用性和问责响应。这些机制影响流动性、资本成本和欺诈/误报风险。提出了分层透明度模型，结合标准化分类、叙述驱动因素、结构化数据和升级协议。
AI.theory_contributions: 将透明度从报告输出重新概念化为治理操作系统，建立了透明度机制与投资者结果之间的理论联系，提出了综合的透明度影响框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高问责投资组合设计了分层透明度模型，提供了具体的实施框架（如与COSO内部控制框架对齐），强调可复制监督和可信保证的重要性。

title: A Robust Approach to Tilting: Parametric Relative Entropy
affiliations: European Central Bank, European Central Bank and European Stability Mechanism

detail.title: A Robust Approach to Tilting: Parametric Relative Entropy
detail.abstract: We introduce a novel methodology, ”parametric tilting,” for incorporating external information into econometric model-based density forecasts. Unlike traditional entropic tilting, which can generate unrealistic or unstable distributions under certain conditions, parametric tilting ensures more reliable and numerically stable results. Our approach leverages the flexibility of the skew-T distribution, which captures key moments of macroeconomic time series, and minimizes the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the target and model-based distributions. This method overcomes limitations of entropic tilting, such as multimodal or degenerate distributions, providing a robust alternative for policymakers and researchers aiming to integrate external views into probabilistic forecasting frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"参数倾斜"的新方法，用于将外部信息纳入计量经济模型密度预测中。该方法使用偏斜T分布来捕捉宏观经济时间序列的关键矩特征，并通过最小化目标分布与模型分布之间的Kullback-Leibler散度，克服了传统熵倾斜方法可能产生不现实或不稳定分布的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何将外部信息有效且可靠地整合到计量经济模型的密度预测中，避免传统熵倾斜方法可能产生的不现实或不稳定分布？
AI.motivation: 传统熵倾斜方法在将外部信息纳入密度预测时，在某些条件下可能产生多峰或退化的不现实分布，导致预测结果不稳定，这对政策制定者和研究人员在概率预测框架中整合外部观点构成了限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息论中的Kullback-Leibler散度最小化理论，结合偏斜T分布（skew-T distribution）的灵活性，该分布能够有效捕捉宏观经济时间序列的关键矩特征。
AI.method: 提出"参数倾斜"方法，使用偏斜T分布作为目标分布，通过最小化目标分布与模型基础分布之间的Kullback-Leibler散度，将外部信息整合到密度预测中。
AI.findings: 参数倾斜方法相比传统熵倾斜方法，能够产生更可靠和数值稳定的分布结果，避免了多峰或退化分布的问题，为整合外部观点提供了更稳健的替代方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了参数倾斜的理论框架，扩展了将外部信息整合到密度预测的方法论，为信息整合提供了更稳健的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了更可靠的工具，用于在概率预测框架中整合外部观点，提高了密度预测的实用性和可靠性。

title: From Mixing to Integration: The Role of Informational Gradients in Friendship Formation
affiliations: Jiaxing University, Fudan University - China Center for Economic Studies (CCES) and Fudan University

detail.title: From Mixing to Integration: The Role of Informational Gradients in Friendship Formation
detail.abstract: Cross-group friendships between local and nonlocal residents serve as a pivotal, yet latent, indicator of social integration. This paper develops a novel Poisson detection model leveraging high-frequency dining-card transaction data from a Chinese university to reconstruct a large-scale social network, identifying tens of thousands of friend pairs within millions of dyads. We find a significant asymmetry in friendship formation: while local students residing with nonlocal peers show an increased propensity to form friendships with individuals from that specific province, nonlocal students do not exhibit a reciprocal effect. We attribute this phenomenon to an experiential learning mechanism governed by informational gradients: daily exposure most effectively reshapes stereotypes when the outgroup member belongs to a numerically smaller group, where the marginal value of information is highest.

AI.tldr: 利用中国大学餐饮卡高频交易数据，通过泊松检测模型重构大规模社交网络，发现本地与非本地学生友谊形成存在显著不对称性：与外地同学同住的本地学生更可能与特定省份同学交友，但外地学生无此互惠效应，这归因于信息梯度驱动的经验学习机制。
AI.research_question: 本地与非本地居民之间的跨群体友谊形成机制是什么？特别是，共同居住环境如何影响不同群体间的友谊形成？
AI.motivation: 跨群体友谊是社会融合的关键但隐性指标，传统调查方法难以大规模准确测量，需要利用新型数据和方法来理解友谊形成的微观机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会融合理论、友谊形成理论、经验学习理论、信息梯度理论、群体接触理论
AI.method: 基于中国大学餐饮卡高频交易数据，开发新型泊松检测模型重构大规模社交网络，从数百万对关系中识别数万对朋友关系，分析友谊形成模式。
AI.findings: 发现友谊形成存在显著不对称性：与外地同学同住的本地学生更可能与特定省份同学交友，但外地学生无此互惠效应；这种不对称性源于信息梯度驱动的经验学习机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出信息梯度驱动的经验学习机制解释友谊形成不对称性；2) 发展了基于高频交易数据的社交网络重构方法；3) 深化了对群体接触理论的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为高校宿舍分配政策提供实证依据；2) 为社会融合政策设计提供新视角；3) 展示了大数据在社会科学研究中的应用价值。

title: Protecting the Beat: Copyright Protection in Nigeria’s Digital Music Landscape
affiliations: Enugu State University of Science and Technology, Enugu State University of Science and Technology and Enugu State University of Science and Technology, Enugu State University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Protecting the Beat: Copyright Protection in Nigeria’s Digital Music Landscape
detail.abstract: In the dynamic rhythm of Nigeria’s vibrant creative landscape, Intellectual Property (I.P) serves as the silent beat that safeguards brands, protect innovation and fuels artistic expression. Through systems like copyright, trademark, patent, etc, creators are granted legal protection for their works. However, with the swift advancement in technology and artificial intelligence (AI), new complexities have been introduced demanding a more adaptive role for I.P Law. As Nigeria’s music industry continues to expand, emerging challenges in copyright infringement have become increasingly prominent. Issues surrounding copyright infringement from digital streaming platforms and deepfake voice cloning represent modern threats to creative ownership. Hence, there is a need to protect the creative rights of artistes through responsive policies, advanced detection tools and collaborative efforts across relevant sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了尼日利亚创意产业中知识产权保护面临的挑战，特别是在音乐行业，随着数字流媒体平台和深度伪造语音克隆等新技术的发展，版权侵权问题日益突出，需要适应性强的法律框架、先进检测工具和跨部门协作来保护创作者权益。
AI.research_question: 在尼日利亚创意产业快速发展的背景下，特别是在音乐行业中，如何应对数字流媒体平台和深度伪造语音克隆等新技术带来的版权侵权挑战，并建立有效的知识产权保护机制？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚创意产业蓬勃发展，知识产权作为保护品牌、创新和艺术表达的基础机制面临严峻挑战。随着技术和人工智能的快速发展，特别是数字流媒体平台和深度伪造语音克隆技术的出现，传统的知识产权法律框架已无法有效应对新兴的侵权问题，需要探索更适应性的保护方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权理论（包括版权、商标、专利等法律框架），数字时代知识产权保护理论，技术发展对法律适应性的影响理论，以及创意产业生态系统理论。
AI.method: 基于文献综述和案例分析的方法，分析尼日利亚音乐产业中的版权侵权现状，特别是数字流媒体平台和深度伪造语音克隆技术的具体案例，提出政策建议和技术解决方案。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）尼日利亚音乐产业面临数字流媒体平台版权侵权的系统性挑战；2）深度伪造语音克隆技术对艺术家创作所有权构成新型威胁；3）现有知识产权法律框架在应对新技术挑战方面存在滞后性；4）需要多维度解决方案来保护创作者权益。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）扩展了数字时代知识产权保护的理论框架；2）提出了技术驱动下法律适应性理论的新视角；3）丰富了发展中国家创意产业知识产权保护的理论研究；4）为人工智能时代版权保护提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为尼日利亚政策制定者提供应对数字版权侵权的政策建议；2）为创意产业从业者提供保护自身权益的实用指南；3）推动开发先进的版权检测工具和技术解决方案；4）促进政府部门、技术公司和创意产业之间的跨部门协作机制。

title: Labor Market Information Frictions and Credit Access: Evidence from Salary History Bans
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University (NTU) and Nanyang Technological University

detail.title: Labor Market Information Frictions and Credit Access: Evidence from Salary History Bans
detail.abstract: We examine how information frictions in wage-setting affect household credit access. Using staggered adoption of Salary History Bans across U.S. states, we show that restricting employers from conditioning job offers on past wages leads to a 24 percent increase in borrowing among households experiencing job transitions. Consistent with an information channel, the effects are concentrated among young, low-income, and low-wealth renters, whose earnings histories are less informative of creditworthiness. Borrowing shifts toward vehicle and education loans rather than broad leverage increases. Credit denials do not rise, and reliance on high-cost lenders declines, providing evidence of improved access to formal credit.

AI.tldr: 美国各州逐步实施薪资历史禁令后，限制雇主根据过往工资制定工作邀约，导致经历工作转换的家庭借款增加24%，特别是年轻、低收入、低财富的租房者，借款主要转向车辆和教育贷款而非全面杠杆增加。
AI.research_question: 工资设定中的信息摩擦如何影响家庭信贷获取？
AI.motivation: 了解信息不对称在劳动力市场和信贷市场交叉点的影响，特别是雇主获取薪资历史信息如何影响家庭信贷可得性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学、信贷市场摩擦理论、劳动力市场信息不对称理论
AI.method: 使用美国各州逐步实施薪资历史禁令的自然实验，采用双重差分法分析政策变化对家庭借款行为的影响
AI.findings: 1. 薪资历史禁令导致经历工作转换的家庭借款增加24%；2. 效果集中在年轻、低收入、低财富的租房者群体；3. 借款主要转向车辆和教育贷款；4. 信贷拒绝率未上升，对高成本贷款机构的依赖减少
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了劳动力市场信息摩擦对信贷市场的溢出效应；2. 提供了信息不对称影响信贷获取的直接证据；3. 拓展了工资设定与信贷市场关联的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了限制薪资历史查询可能改善信贷获取的证据；2. 帮助金融机构理解劳动力市场政策变化对信贷需求的影响；3. 为弱势群体提供改善信贷获取的潜在政策工具

title: China's Influence at the United Nations: Words and Deeds
affiliations: Bruegel and Bruegel

detail.title: China's Influence at the United Nations: Words and Deeds
detail.abstract: We investigate China's influence at the United Nations by focusing on the promotion of its narratives (words) and its voting behaviour (deeds). For the former, we assess the extent to which China's global initiatives have become embedded in UN discourse compared to Western initiatives. For the latter, we assess the degree to which countries, regions and voting coalitions align their UN General Assembly votes with China compared to the US. When it comes to words, China's global initiatives are sometimes louder than the West's. More specifically, the Belt and Road Initiative has had a much greater impact on UN discourse than any Western initiative. Other Chinese global initiatives do not clearly stand out from those of the West, with the Global Compact for Migration mentioned more frequently at the UN than any Chinese initiative other than the BRI. We also find that Chinese initiatives are more self-referential. Thematically, both Chinese and Western initiatives are very focused on security as well as aid and human rights. Moving to voting patterns, countries' income levels are a key determinant of alignment in voting. Poorer countries are much more aligned with China than with the US. North America and the European Union, in that order, are generally more aligned with the US than with China and these trends are much more stable than one could expect given China's growing economic influence.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析中国在联合国的叙事推广（话语）和投票行为（行动），评估中国在联合国的影响力。研究发现：一带一路倡议在联合国话语中的影响力远超西方倡议；中国倡议更倾向于自我引用；投票方面，贫困国家更倾向于与中国而非美国保持一致投票。
AI.research_question: 中国在联合国的影响力如何？具体表现为：1）中国的全球倡议在联合国话语中的嵌入程度如何？2）各国、各地区和投票联盟在联合国大会投票中与中国和美国的对齐程度如何？
AI.motivation: 随着中国在全球事务中日益增长的影响力，需要实证评估中国在联合国这一重要多边平台上的实际影响力，特别是在话语推广和投票行为两个维度上的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系中的话语权力理论、投票联盟理论、软实力理论，以及国际组织中的议程设置和规范扩散理论。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法：1）话语分析：评估中国和西方全球倡议在联合国文件中的出现频率和嵌入程度；2）投票数据分析：量化各国、各地区和投票联盟在联合国大会投票中与中国和美国的对齐程度，并进行统计比较。
AI.findings: 1）话语层面：一带一路倡议在联合国话语中的影响力远超任何西方倡议；其他中国倡议与西方倡议差异不明显；中国倡议更倾向于自我引用；中西方倡议都高度关注安全和援助/人权主题。2）投票层面：国家收入水平是投票对齐的关键决定因素，贫困国家更倾向于与中国而非美国保持一致；北美和欧盟更倾向于与美国保持一致，且这种趋势比预期更为稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了评估国家在联合国影响力的多维分析框架（话语vs行动）；2）揭示了话语影响力和投票影响力之间的不对称性；3）挑战了经济影响力必然转化为投票影响力的假设；4）深化了对发展中国家投票行为决定因素的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了中国在联合国影响力的实证评估；2）揭示了不同地区和国家群体对中美投票模式的差异；3）为理解中国全球倡议的实际传播效果提供了证据；4）为预测联合国投票趋势提供了参考依据。

title: Justice-as-a-Protocol: Designing a Stateless, Scalable, and Self-Enforcing Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) System for 21st Century India
affiliations: K K Wagh Institute of Engineering Education and Research, K K Wagh Institute of Engineering Education and Research, K K Wagh Institute of Engineering Education and Research, K K Wagh Institute of Engineering Education and Research, K K Wagh Institute of Engineering Education and Research and K K Wagh Institute of Engineering Education and Research

detail.title: Justice-as-a-Protocol: Designing a Stateless, Scalable, and Self-Enforcing Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) System for 21st Century India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or experiments requiring ethical approval. The research is conceptual and design-oriented in nature; therefore, formal ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: In the face of rising caseloads and the increasing strain on traditional judicial systems, Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) offers a transformative alternative-leveraging technology to deliver faster, more accessible, and cost-effective justice. However, even the most advanced ODR platforms encounter a major constraint: the cognitive burden placed on human adjudicators, particularly retired judges who often serve as arbitrators or mediators. This research proposes a novel AI augmented ODR framework that synergizes human expertise with machine intelligence. Specifically, it introduces an AI-powered assistant engineered to support retired legal professionals by automating legal summarization, document interpretation, evidence synthesis, and case-history insights. The objective is not to replace human judgment, but to enhance decision-making accuracy, reduce cognitive fatigue, and bridge generational gaps in technology adoption. By merging ethical AI design with judicial experience, this project envisions a future where age, geography, or complexity no longer hinder access to timely and fair dispute resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种AI增强的在线纠纷解决(ODR)框架，通过AI助手协助退休法官等法律专业人士，自动化法律摘要、文件解释、证据合成和案例历史分析，旨在减轻认知负担、提高决策准确性，而非取代人类判断。
AI.research_question: 如何通过AI技术增强在线纠纷解决系统，减轻退休法官等法律专业人士的认知负担，同时提高决策准确性和效率？
AI.motivation: 传统司法系统面临案件量增加的压力，在线纠纷解决(ODR)虽然提供了更快、更易获取、成本更低的替代方案，但现有ODR平台仍面临重大限制：人类裁决者（特别是常担任仲裁员或调解员的退休法官）承受的认知负担过重。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI增强决策理论、人机协同框架、认知负荷理论、技术接受模型（特别是针对老年专业人士的采纳障碍）、司法决策辅助系统理论
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的AI增强ODR框架，具体包括：1）开发AI助手支持退休法律专业人士；2）自动化法律摘要生成；3）文件解释；4）证据合成；5）案例历史洞察分析。采用人机协同设计理念，将人类专业知识与机器智能相结合。
AI.findings: 该AI增强ODR框架能够：1）减轻退休法官的认知疲劳；2）提高决策准确性；3）弥合技术采纳的代际差距；4）不取代人类判断而是增强之；5）通过结合伦理AI设计与司法经验，使年龄、地理或复杂性不再阻碍及时公正的纠纷解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了AI增强司法决策的新理论框架；2）发展了人机协同在ODR领域的应用理论；3）扩展了认知负荷理论在司法环境中的应用；4）为老年专业人士技术采纳障碍提供了解决方案理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了实用的AI助手工具，支持退休法律专业人士；2）提高了ODR系统的效率和可及性；3）减少了司法系统的压力；4）促进了更公平、及时的纠纷解决；5）为司法系统数字化转型提供了可行方案。

title: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Simulation Architecture for Catastrophe Tail Risk and Reinsurance Portfolio Optimization
affiliations: Independent

(QRS), a commercial entity that develops and commercializes the hybrid quantum-classical simulation architecture and Heterogeneous Backend Scheduler discussed in this manuscript. The author has a direct financial interest in the commercial success of the technology evaluated in this study.

detail.abstract: The accurate estimation of catastrophe tail risk-specifically Value at Risk (VaR) and Tail Value at Risk (TVaR) at extreme percentiles-poses a profound computational challenge for the global reinsurance industry. Traditional classical Monte Carlo (MC) simulations suffer from high estimator variance and severe sample inefficiency when modeling low-probability, high-severity events. In this paper, we introduce a hybrid quantum-classical simulation architecture designed to reduce estimator variance and optimize non-proportional reinsurance layer structures. Our system integrates physicsbased classical catastrophe modeling with Quantum Amplitude Estimation (QAE) and Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (VQE) to efficiently sample heavy-tailed loss distributions. To bridge the gap between theoretical quantum speedups and Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) hardware realities, our system introduces a dynamic backend scheduler driven by a multi-variable scoring function balancing precision, queue latency, and cost, alongside Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE) for error mitigation. Furthermore, we present a Capital Efficiency (𝐶𝐸) objective function used for portfolio optimization. Experimental benchmarks on a synthetic coastal hurricane portfolio demonstrate that the proposed architecture achieves tail precision equivalent to approximately 2.0 × 10 ! classical Monte Carlo samples using only 7.5 × 10 " quantum shots-a 96.25% reduction in sample complexity-yielding a 35% reduction in estimator variance at the 99.5th percentile.

title: Methodology and philosophy of research on the Cost-Benefit Analysis of the European Union Emission Trading System 2 (EU ETS2) in the urban public transport in Poland

detail.title: Methodology and philosophy of research on the Cost-Benefit Analysis of the European Union Emission Trading System 2 (EU ETS2) in the urban public transport in Poland

contentType.other: Working paper - preliminary version of PhD research, seeking feedback

detail.abstract: This paper outlines the philosophical and methodological foundations of a doctoral research project examining the economic and social costs and benefits of the European Union Emissions Trading System 2 (EU ETS2) in Poland's urban public transport sector. Anchored in a critical realist perspective, the study integrates quantitative and qualitative methods to capture both measurable financial impacts and the underlying mechanisms shaping stakeholder responses. The research employs a Cost-Benefit Analysis as its principal analytical framework, complemented by comparative assessment, Delphi expert elicitation, and diagnostic surveys of urban transport operators. Situated at the meso level, the analysis focuses on sector-wide implications, including cost pass-through dynamics, investment requirements, distributional effects, and alignment with sustainable development and climate-justice principles. Particular attention is devoted to methodological challenges stemming from regulatory uncertainty, data constraints, and the normative dimensions of monetizing social outcomes. By synthesizing theoretical, empirical, and axiological considerations, the study aims to provide a comprehensive and policy-relevant evaluation of EU ETS2's prospective impacts on urban mobility and the conditions for its effective and socially equitable implementation.

title: Fair Dealing in India: An Analysis vis-à-vis Fair Use in the United States

detail.title: Fair Dealing in India: An Analysis vis-à-vis Fair Use in the United States

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Intellectual Property Rights, volume 29, issue 6, 2024[10.56042/jipr.v29i6.7528]

detail.abstract: One form of intellectual property that has seen tremendous growth in recent times is copyright. The main objective of copyright protection is to encourage authors to create and give them the opportunity to profit from their hard work. However, since the ultimate aim of the copyright law is to promote, advance and disseminate knowledge in the public interest, copyright exceptions and limitations are the main mechanisms for ensuring a fair balance between the competing interests of copyright owners on one side and the public on the other. The most important and significant restriction on the exclusive rights of holder of a copyright is the exception of 'fair dealing'. Section 52 of the Indian Copyright Act, 1957 contains the provisions relating to 'fair dealing'. It is a list of potential defences against a claim that an exclusive copyright has been violated. As opposed to the equivalent American concept of 'fair use', any act that does not fit into one of the specified categories is not subject to 'fair dealing'. This paper aims to draw points of differences between 'Fair Dealing' in India and 'Fair Use' in the USA. The objective of the paper is to analyse both doctrines and their scope and lacunae if any, in respective countries.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了印度版权法中的"公平交易"与美国版权法中的"公平使用"两种例外制度，分析两者的差异、适用范围及各自存在的缺陷。

AI.motivation: 版权保护旨在激励创作，但版权法的最终目标是促进公共利益中的知识传播。版权例外和限制机制是平衡版权所有者利益与公共利益的关键工具，而"公平交易"和"公平使用"是其中最重要的例外制度。理解这两种制度的差异对于完善版权平衡机制具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 版权平衡理论：版权需要在创作者激励与公共利益之间取得平衡
2. 版权例外理论：例外条款作为平衡机制的法律基础
3. 比较法理论：通过比较不同法域的版权例外制度来理解制度设计的差异
AI.method: 比较分析法：对印度1957年《版权法》第52条规定的"公平交易"制度与美国版权法中的"公平使用"原则进行系统比较分析，包括概念界定、适用范围、法律机制等方面的对比。
AI.findings:

2. 印度制度确定性更强但灵活性不足，美国制度灵活性更高但确定性较弱
3. 两种制度在平衡版权所有者利益与公共利益方面各有优劣
AI.theory_contributions:

2. 揭示了封闭式列举与开放式原则两种立法模式的理论差异
3. 为版权平衡理论提供了具体的制度比较案例
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为印度版权法改革提供参考，建议考虑增加制度灵活性
2. 为版权实践者提供两种制度的操作指导

detail.abstract: The global industrial ecosystem faces an "Interoperability Crisis" caused by static data exchange models and divergent governance domains. Traditional approaches treat industrial data as independent documents, leading to inefficiency, high transformation costs, and verification failures. This paper introduces the General Theory of Data Physics, a systems engineering framework derived from first principles. We posit that industrial data is not a static asset but a "State Derivative" (D = dS/dt) of the physical entity. Based on this axiom, we propose three fundamental laws: (1) The Law of Ontological Orthogonality, which decouples intrinsic physical attributes from extrinsic compliance contexts; (2) The Mechanics of Value Coupling, distinguishing between coupled verification states and decoupled asset tokens; and (3) The Temporal Continuity Principle, prioritizing continuous state functions over discrete snapshots.

detail.abstract: Modern decision-making increasingly relies on abstract models, expert opinions, and theoretical predictions that often fail to reflect lived reality. Consumers buy products that fail early, institutions invest in systems that decay rapidly, and societies repeatedly misjudge trust, longevity, and value. This paper proposes ALT (Average LifeTime)a universal, database-centric framework that derives reality truth from aggregated lived experiences rather than from theory, authority, or isolated expertise. ALT treats crowdsourced empirical databases as the primary source of truth and uses AI to synthesize, weight, and compare them. Originally conceived for products and services, ALT is shown to be extensible to human trustworthiness, education systems, food quality, governance structures, biological entities, and even space systems. When multiple ALT databases exist, a higher-order AI structure can automatically select or combine them to guide optimal decisions. ALT represents a shift from model-first reasoning to reality-first reasoning, enabling individuals and societies to make their next move with the highest probability of alignment with actual outcomes.

detail.title: Standard for Field Demonstration of Simultaneous SO & CO₂ Capture in Existing Wet Flue Gas Desulfurization Systems
detail.abstract:
This document presents HySORB-FG, a normative technical standard that defines a structured framework for conducting temporary, reversible field demonstrations of simultaneous sulfur dioxide (SO₂) and carbon dioxide (CO₂) capture within existing wet flue gas desulfurization (FGD) systems. The standard is designed to enable disciplined, engineering-led evaluation of modified alkaline slurry chemistries under real plant operating conditions, without permanent modification to absorber vessels, ductwork, or major mechanical equipment.

HySORB-FG establishes requirements and guidance covering system applicability, operating boundaries, slurry chemistry envelopes, phased test protocols, gas-, liquid-, and solid-phase monitoring, mass balance reconciliation, safety management, rollback criteria, and data reporting. A phase-gated testing logic is employed to ensure preservation of baseline SO₂ control performance prior to escalation toward evaluation of CO₂ uptake, aligning demonstration activities with utility risk management practices.

The standard deliberately avoids prescribing specific chemistries, performance targets, or commercial outcomes. Instead, it provides a conservative, technology-agnostic framework intended to promote repeatable field testing, protect host facility operability and regulatory compliance, and support transparent interpretation of results. HySORB-FG is intended for voluntary use by utilities, industrial facility owners, engineering firms, technology developers, and researchers seeking to explore the incremental carbon capture potential of existing wet FGD assets while maintaining primary environmental control functions.

AI.method: 建立包含系统适用性、操作边界、浆液化学范围、分阶段测试协议、多相监测、质量平衡、安全管理、回退标准和数据报告的技术标准框架。
AI.findings: HySORB-FG标准提供了一个技术中性的结构化框架，支持在现有FGD系统中进行可逆的SO₂/CO₂同时捕集现场演示，保护设施运行和监管合规性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了相控测试逻辑和保守的工程框架，为现有环境控制系统的增量碳捕集潜力评估提供了标准化的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力公司、工业设施所有者、工程公司和技术开发者提供了实用的现场测试标准，支持在不影响原有SO₂控制功能的前提下探索碳捕集潜力。

title: General Theory of Non-Financial Arbitrage in Economics
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: General Theory of Non-Financial Arbitrage in Economics
detail.abstract: This paper defines arbitrage as the systematic exploitation of structural asymmetries to extract economic value disproportionate to value created, further extending the concept of financial arbitrage to encompass systematic value extraction through non-market asymmetries in economics. This paper establishes five foundational criteria that distinguishes non-financial arbitrage from mere opportunism or fraud, structural asymmetry, disproportionate value extraction, economic manifestation, systematic replicability, and resistance to elimination. This paper develops a comprehensive taxonomy spanning ten distinct types across four categories, namely Definitional Arbitrages (agency, obligation), Perceptual Arbitrages (temporal sovereignty, cognitive, attention), Power Arbitrages (resource access, scale), and Systemic Arbitrages (regulatory, institutional, informational). This framework unifies phenomena previously scattered across behavioral economics, information theory, organizational studies, and political economy. This paper concludes with outlines of implications for applied economics, development economics, economic sociology, economic theory, and the political economy together with future research agendas.

AI.tldr: 该论文将套利概念从金融领域扩展到非金融领域，定义为利用结构性不对称系统性地提取与创造价值不成比例的经济价值，建立了区分非金融套利与机会主义或欺诈的五项标准，并提出了涵盖四大类十种类型的综合分类体系。
AI.research_question: 如何将金融套利概念扩展到非金融领域，建立系统性的非金融套利理论框架？
AI.motivation: 传统金融套利概念局限于市场环境，无法解释许多通过非市场不对称性系统提取价值的经济现象，需要建立更全面的理论框架来统一分析这些分散在不同学科中的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将套利理论从金融经济学扩展到行为经济学、信息理论、组织研究和政治经济学，建立基于结构性不对称的系统性价值提取理论。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论构建方法，通过定义核心概念、建立区分标准、发展分类体系，构建非金融套利的综合理论框架。
AI.findings: 1. 定义了非金融套利的五项核心标准：结构性不对称、不成比例的价值提取、经济表现、系统性可复制性、消除阻力；2. 建立了四大类十种类型的分类体系：定义性套利（代理、义务）、感知性套利（时间主权、认知、注意力）、权力套利（资源获取、规模）、系统性套利（监管、制度、信息）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了套利概念的理论边界；2. 建立了统一的分析框架，整合了分散在不同学科中的现象；3. 提供了区分套利与机会主义/欺诈的理论标准；4. 为跨学科研究提供了概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者识别和应对非金融套利提供分析工具；2. 为企业管理者理解市场不对称性提供框架；3. 为发展经济学、应用经济学等领域提供新的分析视角；4. 为未来研究指明方向。

title: Updating the EU strategy on China: Co-existence while Derisking through Partnerships
affiliations: Bruegel and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Updating the EU strategy on China: Co-existence while Derisking through Partnerships
detail.abstract:
Executive summary

The European Union-China relationship has deteriorated markedly since the EU introduced a three-part strategy in 2019 based on partnership, competition and systemic rivalry. Th e relationship has been undermined by China’s support for Russia’s aggression in Ukraine and its increasingly anti-Western foreign policy that aims to alter the international rules-based system. Meanwhile, the economic relationship is changing because of China’s structural deceleration and increasing self-reliance, coupled with the EU’s growing critical dependence on China, especially for digitalisation and decarbonisation. Europe must accept that relations with China will not return to their pre-pandemic state. 

While there is no need to change the overall strategy, the EU should seek co-existence with China while preserving EU values and interests. Cooperation is still needed to address global problems, including climate change, in which China plays an important role in finding solutions, but on which the EU cannot accept Chinese cooperation at any price. 

In terms of co-existence, the EU must continue to pursue de-risking – or reducing its exposure to China – especially for its energy and digital transitions. De-risking has started but more needs to be done to understand how it can be continued while not creating conflict. 

The EU should pursue a three-part approach: increase coherence and coordination with all European stakeholders, refi ne the EU economic-security strategy while accepting trade-offs and seek partnerships as the best offensive tool. The 2024-2029 European Commission should foster discussion of China and coordination of strategic issues within a larger constituency. EU countries, with Commission coordination, need to be more involved in building a comprehensive approach, including by conducting national risk assessments and by shaping and implementing de-risking measures. 

On economic security, full implementation of current defensive instruments is needed, along with new protections, such as better coordination of export controls and a new outbound-investment screening mechanism. The trade-off s stemming from pursuing more security will need to be made explicit in order to mitigate them. 

On partnerships, the EU must look beyond the United States, working within the G7 and with other like-minded countries, such as Australia and South Korea, which have valuable experience of de-risking. Mutually beneficial and strategic cooperation agreements need to be brokered with relevant emerging and developing economies.

AI.tldr: 欧盟-中国关系自2019年欧盟提出"伙伴关系、竞争、系统性对手"三部分战略后显著恶化。中国支持俄罗斯侵略乌克兰、推行反西方外交政策，同时经济关系因中国经济结构性减速、自给自足增强而改变。欧盟需接受关系不会回到疫情前状态，应寻求与中国共存，同时推进去风险化，特别是在能源和数字转型领域。
AI.research_question: 欧盟应如何在与中国关系恶化、经济依赖加深的背景下，调整其对华战略以实现共存并保护欧盟价值观和利益？
AI.motivation: 欧盟-中国关系自2019年以来显著恶化，中国支持俄罗斯侵略乌克兰、推行反西方外交政策，同时欧盟在数字化和脱碳领域对中国的关键依赖日益加深。欧盟需要应对这一复杂局面，在保持合作解决全球问题的同时，保护自身利益和价值观。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论中的地缘政治竞争、经济相互依赖理论、风险管理理论、战略共存理论，以及欧盟对外政策分析框架。
AI.method: 政策分析报告方法，基于对欧盟-中国关系现状的评估，结合地缘政治、经济和安全因素分析，提出具体的政策建议和战略调整方案。
AI.findings: 1. 欧盟-中国关系已发生根本性变化，不会回到疫情前状态；2. 欧盟需要在保持合作解决全球问题的同时，推进去风险化战略；3. 经济安全需要全面实施现有防御工具并开发新保护措施；4. 欧盟需要超越美国，在G7框架内与志同道合国家合作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在系统性竞争背景下实现"战略共存"的理论框架，探讨了经济相互依赖与安全风险之间的平衡机制，为理解后疫情时代大国关系提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟提供了具体的政策建议：1) 加强欧洲利益相关者协调；2) 完善经济安全战略并明确权衡取舍；3) 建立伙伴关系作为最佳进攻工具；4) 推进去风险化措施；5) 与G7及其他志同道合国家合作。

title: Strategic Dysfunction: Why Governments Use Administrative Friction as a Fiscal Safety Valve
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Strategic Dysfunction: Why Governments Use Administrative Friction as a Fiscal Safety Valve

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Did you know, Every year billions of dollars in social benefits go unclaimed every year by people who are legally entitled to them. In the United States, roughly 12% of eligible individuals do not claim SNAP benefits.(fns.usda.gov) Now you might think that this is the government, it's their job to distribute the funds why isn't it being done properly. One main misconception people assume is "government incompetence" or "bad websites". To some extent the thinking is correct, but if we look closely, what if this failure is actually a Stable Equilibrium? What if this persistent gap in benefit take up represents a strategic trade off between the citizen's participation costs and the government's budgetary constraints? This paper presents an argument that underutilisation is a Strategic Dysfunction. Using two models, the paper will demonstrate that participation costs act as a filter for the individual and a fiscal safety net for the government.

AI.tldr: 本文认为社会福利领取不足是一种战略功能障碍，而非简单的政府无能。通过两个模型分析，证明参与成本既作为个人筛选机制，又作为政府财政安全网，形成稳定均衡。
AI.research_question: 为什么每年数十亿美元的社会福利未被合法有资格的人领取？这种领取不足现象是否代表公民参与成本与政府预算约束之间的战略权衡？
AI.motivation: 美国约12%符合条件的人不领取SNAP福利，传统解释归因于"政府无能"或"网站糟糕"，但本文认为这可能是稳定均衡的战略功能障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略功能障碍理论、稳定均衡理论、参与成本作为筛选机制、政府预算约束理论
AI.method: 使用两个理论模型进行分析：第一个模型展示参与成本如何作为个人筛选机制；第二个模型展示参与成本如何作为政府财政安全网
AI.findings: 福利领取不足是战略均衡结果：参与成本既筛选出真正需要的个人，又帮助政府控制预算，形成稳定状态而非单纯失败
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"战略功能障碍"概念，挑战传统"政府无能"解释；建立参与成本双重作用的理论框架；将福利领取不足重新概念化为均衡结果
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供新视角：参与成本设计可作为政策工具；帮助理解福利系统内在权衡；为福利改革提供理论基础

title: How Does Competition Affect Firms’ Carbon Performance? Firm-Level Evidence from Tariff Cuts
affiliations: University of Augsburg, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Augsburg and University of St. Gallen - School of Finance

detail.title: How Does Competition Affect Firms’ Carbon Performance? Firm-Level Evidence from Tariff Cuts
detail.abstract: We examine how changes in competition affect firms’ carbon performance. Exploiting reductions in import tariffs as a quasi-natural experiment that increases competitive pressure, we find that stronger competition improves firms’ carbon efficiency through lower Scope 1 and 2 emission intensities. These results remain robust to alternative specifications, heterogeneous treatment effects, and placebo tests. Mechanism analyses indicate systematic differences in firms’ strategic responses. High-emission-intensity firms tend to adopt visible environmental actions and reallocate resources toward intangible assets, whereas low-emission firms increase investment and internal financing activities. Overall, our results highlight competition as a determinant of corporate decarbonization, suggesting that market forces can complement regulatory approaches to improving firms’ environmental performance.

AI.tldr: 研究竞争变化对企业碳绩效的影响，发现进口关税降低带来的竞争加剧会提高企业碳效率，主要通过降低范围1和范围2排放强度实现
AI.research_question: 竞争变化如何影响企业的碳绩效？
AI.motivation: 理解市场力量（竞争）如何影响企业环境绩效，特别是碳减排，为监管政策提供补充视角
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争理论、企业战略响应理论、环境绩效理论
AI.method: 利用进口关税降低作为准自然实验，采用替代性规范、异质性处理效应和安慰剂检验等稳健性检验
AI.findings: 更强的竞争通过降低范围1和范围2排放强度提高企业碳效率；高排放企业倾向于采取可见环境行动和重新配置资源到无形资产，低排放企业增加投资和内部融资活动
AI.theory_contributions: 将竞争识别为企业脱碳的决定因素，扩展了竞争与环境绩效关系的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 表明市场力量可以补充监管方法改善企业环境绩效，为政策制定者提供新工具

title: Investor Attention and Stock Returns under Collusive Trading
affiliations: Hanyang University - School of  Business and Hanyang University

detail.title: Investor Attention and Stock Returns under Collusive Trading
detail.abstract: We investigate the effect of investor attention on stock return under the setting of collusive trading. Using a unique case of collusive trading, a type of stock price manipulation, this paper shows that the positive link between investor attention and stock returns disappears under collusive trading. Prior to the period of collusive trading, investor attention influences stock returns as expected, but collusive trades break this linkage. Comparisons with price run-up stocks and propensity score-matched stocks confirm that this disruption occurs only to stocks of collusive trading. Difference-in-Difference and placebo tests indicate that collusive trading drives these effects. These findings suggest that monitoring investor attention can serve as an early warning for a special form of stock price manipulation, providing a practical tool for market surveillance.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在合谋交易（一种股价操纵形式）背景下，投资者关注度与股票回报之间的正相关关系会消失，这可以作为股价操纵的早期预警信号。
AI.research_question: 在合谋交易（股价操纵）背景下，投资者关注度对股票回报的影响会发生什么变化？
AI.motivation: 投资者关注度通常与股票回报正相关，但合谋交易可能破坏这种关系，研究这种破坏效应有助于开发市场监控工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资者关注度理论、股价操纵理论、市场效率理论
AI.method: 使用独特的合谋交易案例，比较合谋交易前后投资者关注度与股票回报的关系，采用价格飙升股票和倾向得分匹配股票作为对照组，进行双重差分和安慰剂检验
AI.findings: 1. 合谋交易前，投资者关注度与股票回报正相关；2. 合谋交易期间，这种正相关关系消失；3. 这种破坏效应仅出现在合谋交易股票中；4. 合谋交易是导致这种效应的原因
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了合谋交易如何破坏投资者关注度与股票回报的正常关系，拓展了投资者关注度理论在异常市场环境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 监控投资者关注度可以作为股价操纵的早期预警工具，为市场监管提供实用方法

title: Oil Price and Sectoral Volatility Spillovers
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Oil Price and Sectoral Volatility Spillovers

keywords.keywords: Oil Price Volatility: Intraday Spillovers: Sectoral Stock Indices: Volatility Connectedness: High-Frequency Data: Oil-Importing and Exporting Economies

detail.abstract: This research looks at the spillovers of intraday volatility. From crude oil prices to sectoral stock indices across major oil-importing and oil-exporting economies. Using high-frequency data collected at 5-minute intervals from July 31, 2020, to April 30, 2021—a period marked by considerable uncertainty due to the global health crisis—the analysis covers five oil-exporting nations and nine oil-importing nations. Ten sectoral indices that capture complex market dynamics are hand-constructed from a sample of 1,689 individual stocks.Based on the data, overall volatility connectedness remains very high after the pandemic’s severe market volatility. Although the strength and direction of these spillovers differ greatly across nations and sectors, there are robust and fluctuating volatility transmission patterns between oil prices and sector indices. In the UK and Norway, oil prices are the main net transmitters of volatility across sectors. On the flip side, oil is primarily a market beneficiary when it comes to the volatility of the US and Canadian sector indices. On the other hand, the correlations between oil price volatility and sectoral markets in South Korea, China, Mexico, and Australia are relatively weak. Findings stress the importance of sector- and country-specific characteristics in impacting volatility transmission mechanisms and the varied character of oil-stock market interactions.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用高频数据分析了原油价格日内波动对主要石油进出口国家行业股票指数的溢出效应，发现疫情后波动关联性依然很高，但不同国家和行业的溢出强度和方向存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 原油价格日内波动如何影响主要石油进出口经济体的行业股票指数？不同国家和行业间的波动溢出强度和方向有何差异？
AI.motivation: 全球健康危机期间市场不确定性加剧，需要理解原油价格波动如何在不同国家和行业间传播，这对投资者风险管理和政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于波动溢出理论、市场联动理论和资产定价理论，研究原油市场与股票市场间的跨市场波动传导机制。
AI.method: 使用2020年7月31日至2021年4月30日期间5分钟间隔的高频数据，涵盖5个石油出口国和9个石油进口国，从1,689只个股手工构建10个行业指数，分析波动关联性。
AI.findings: 疫情后整体波动关联性依然很高；英国和挪威的原油价格是行业波动的主要净传导者；美国和加拿大的行业指数波动主要影响原油市场；韩国、中国、墨西哥和澳大利亚的油价与行业市场关联较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对原油-股票市场波动传导机制的理解，揭示了国家和行业特征在波动溢出中的调节作用，拓展了高频数据在跨市场关联研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供针对不同国家和行业的风险管理策略，帮助政策制定者设计更有效的市场稳定措施，为资产配置决策提供实证依据。

title: Friends and Defaults in a Third Party Dictator Experiment
affiliations: University of California, Merced

detail.title: Friends and Defaults in a Third Party Dictator Experiment
detail.abstract: Commonplace in medical, financial, legal, regulatory and managerial settings are surrogates who make decisions for others. In this paper's experiment, third party Choosers allocate $10 between a proximate Friend and a more distant Receiver. Choosers respond to indicated Friend preferences and defaults that stipulate a baseline allocation that is either equal or unequal (Friend favoring). I _nd that Friends (expressing preferences) and Choosers (selecting allocations) favor defaults, while Choosers predominantly follow their Friends' preferences. Combining e_ects, an equal (v. unequal) default produces a 25 percent increase in equal allocations. Potential implications for organ donation are discussed.

AI.tldr: 实验研究显示，在第三方决策者（Choosers）为朋友和陌生人分配资源时，默认选项和朋友偏好都会影响决策结果。平等默认选项相比不平等默认选项能增加25%的平等分配。
AI.research_question: 第三方决策者如何受到朋友偏好和默认选项的影响，在为朋友和陌生人分配资源时做出决策？
AI.motivation: 在医疗、金融、法律、监管和管理环境中，代理人（surrogates）为他人做决策的现象很常见。研究这种决策过程有助于理解社会偏好和默认选项如何影响资源分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会偏好理论、默认选项效应、代理决策理论、公平与利他主义
AI.method: 实验方法：第三方决策者（Choosers）在实验中分配10美元给朋友（Friend）和更远的接收者（Receiver）。研究操纵两个变量：1）朋友表达的偏好；2）默认选项（平等分配或不平等分配，偏向朋友）。
AI.findings: 1. 朋友（表达偏好）和决策者（选择分配）都倾向于默认选项；2. 决策者主要遵循朋友的偏好；3. 综合效应：平等默认选项相比不平等默认选项能产生25%的平等分配增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了代理决策中朋友偏好和默认选项的交互作用；2. 扩展了社会偏好理论在第三方决策中的应用；3. 为理解默认选项在道德决策中的作用提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对器官捐赠等医疗决策有潜在启示；2. 为设计更有效的默认选项政策提供参考；3. 帮助理解代理人如何平衡朋友偏好和社会公平。
