AI.method: 基于代理的蒙特卡洛模拟，在随机违约条件下对标准双边交换进行基准测试，评估级联动态、累积吞吐量损失和稳定性边界
AI.findings: 1. 对称执行显著减少级联传播；2. 降低冲击期间的系统性吞吐量损失；3. 扩大网络的稳定区域；4. 相空间分析显示执行强度与系统韧性之间存在单调关系
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将承诺介导的协调形式化为内生执行机制；2. 为制度经济学和市场设计提供新框架；3. 识别义务中心架构增强网络化市场稳健性的条件
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为去中心化交换系统设计提供基于对称义务的稳定架构；2. 识别通过强制执行承诺减少系统性风险的具体机制；3. 为市场设计者提供增强网络韧性的实用指导

title: Flooding the Market? How Hurricanes Impact Home Listings
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco and Federal Reserve Board of Governors

detail.title: Flooding the Market? How Hurricanes Impact Home Listings
detail.abstract: The lack of an emerging consensus regarding how home prices respond to natural disasters presents a puzzle: Why do some analyses find increases while others find decreases? We develop a model illustrating how transaction composition shifts between "safe" and "risky" homes can yield positive price effect estimates and declining quantities even when shocks decrease values of homes more broadly. Using property-level disaster risk, treatment, and real estate listing and sales data, we implement a novel approach focusing on listings started immediately before an event in order to limit the role of selection bias. In this sample, we find non-elevated flooded homes are 10 percent less likely to sell while elevated homes in the wider region are 1.4 percent more likely to sell. Listings for non-elevated flooded homes that do end up selling spend over five weeks more on the market and are nine percent more likely to sell at large discounts. We further find that flooded homes listed after the year landfall are more likely to have elevated foundations and less likely to have upgraded features. We also find support for the hypothesis that disasters cause shrink housing market supply, as local projections point to temporary disruptions in listings and sales that are not made up later. These supply effects are more pronounced in more severely flooded Census tracts. Extreme weather events can cause sample selection bias in sales, a phenomenon known as "transaction bias" that can skew price effect estimates and may explain some of the disagreement in the price effect research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自然灾害对房价影响的争议，发现交易样本选择偏差（"交易偏差"）是导致研究结果不一致的关键原因。洪水灾害后，安全房屋交易增加而风险房屋交易减少，造成价格上涨的假象，实际上房屋整体价值下降。
AI.research_question: 为什么关于自然灾害对房价影响的研究结果存在矛盾（有的发现价格上涨，有的发现价格下跌）？交易样本选择偏差如何影响价格效应估计？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对自然灾害如何影响房价缺乏共识，这种不一致性构成了一个研究谜题。理解这种分歧的原因对于准确评估灾害的经济影响至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易偏差理论：自然灾害后，市场交易构成从"风险"房屋向"安全"房屋转移，即使整体房屋价值下降，这种交易构成变化也可能导致观测价格上涨。
AI.method: 使用房产级别的灾害风险、处理数据以及房地产挂牌和销售数据。采用新颖方法，聚焦于灾害事件前立即开始的挂牌，以限制选择偏差的作用。
AI.findings: 1. 未抬高的洪水房屋销售可能性降低10%，而更广泛区域内的抬高房屋销售可能性增加1.4%；2. 最终售出的未抬高洪水房屋在市场上停留时间增加5周以上，且以大幅折扣（9%）售出的可能性更高；3. 灾害后挂牌的洪水房屋更可能有抬高地基，但升级特征更少；4. 灾害导致住房市场供应收缩，在更严重洪水区域尤为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出并验证了"交易偏差"理论，解释了自然灾害研究中价格效应估计的不一致性；2. 发展了考虑交易构成变化的价格效应分析框架；3. 为灾害经济学提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供更准确的灾害经济影响评估方法；2. 帮助房地产投资者和保险公司更好地理解灾害风险定价；3. 为城市规划者提供灾害后住房市场动态的实证依据；4. 提醒研究人员注意交易样本选择偏差对实证结果的影响。

title: Flat-Rate Medicaid Reimbursement and Geographic Variation in Provider Participation: Evidence from California

detail.title: Flat-Rate Medicaid Reimbursement and Geographic Variation in Provider Participation: Evidence from California

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract:
Objective: To quantify geographic and specialty-level variation in Medi-Cal provider participation rates across California's 58 counties and examine the relationship between local practice costs and provider engagement with the program.

Data Sources: NPPES provider registry (2024); HHS Medicaid Provider Spending dataset (January 2018–December 2024); composite practice cost index from BLS wage data, HUD Fair Market Rents, and healthcare purchased services indices.

Study Design: Descriptive analysis of provider participation rates, pooled over a seven-year period (2018–2024), defined as the share of NPPES-registered providers in each county who actively billed Medi-Cal during the study period. Rates were stratified by county, Hospital Referral Region (HRR), and six specialty categories.

Principal Findings: Among 79,223 NPPES-registered providers across California's 58 counties, 31,798 (40.1%) actively billed Medi-Cal. County-level participation ranged from 0% (Sierra County, N=2 providers) to 48.3% (Marin County). Bay Area counties with the highest practice costs (composite cost index 162–186) paradoxically exhibited higher participation (44–48%) than low-cost rural counties (17–30%), suggesting that provider density and institutional infrastructure may matter more than reimbursement adequacy alone. Behavioral health had the lowest median participation (27.3%) across all specialties, with the vast majority of counties clustered between 25% and 29%. Low overall participation (<34%) clusters along the Central Valley and far-north I-5 corridor, with four HRRs (Bakersfield, Modesto, Stockton, and Redding) covering approximately 3.6 million residents.

Conclusions: Medi-Cal's flat-rate reimbursement, which unlike Medicare's GPCI makes no geographic adjustment, produces predictable gaps in provider participation. The positive association between practice costs and participation suggests urban institutional infrastructure buffers against low reimbursement in ways unavailable to rural communities. Geographic payment adjustment and targeted behavioral health investments warrant consideration as states implement new CMS network adequacy requirements. Data are available at https://www.caphegroup.org/tools/access-explorer.

AI.tldr: 本研究量化了加州58个县Medi-Cal提供者参与率的地理和专业差异，发现高成本地区参与率反而更高，表明机构基础设施比报销充足性更重要，建议考虑地理支付调整和行为健康投资。
AI.research_question: 加州Medi-Cal提供者参与率的地理和专业差异如何？地方实践成本与提供者参与计划之间有何关系？
AI.motivation: Medi-Cal的固定费率报销（与Medicare的地理调整不同）可能导致提供者参与的地域差异，影响医疗服务的可及性，特别是在网络充足性要求下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗提供者参与决策的经济模型，考虑报销率、实践成本、机构基础设施和地理因素对参与率的影响。
AI.method: 描述性分析，使用NPPES提供者注册数据（2024年）、HHS Medicaid提供者支出数据（2018-2024年）和综合实践成本指数，计算各县、医院转诊区域和专业类别的参与率。
AI.findings: 1) 加州79,223名注册提供者中40.1%参与Medi-Cal；2) 高成本湾区县参与率（44-48%）高于低成本农村县（17-30%）；3) 行为健康专业参与率最低（27.3%）；4) 低参与率集中在中央谷地和北I-5走廊地区。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了单纯报销充足性决定参与率的假设，强调机构基础设施和提供者密度在缓冲低报销影响中的作用，为医疗提供者参与决策模型提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供地理支付调整的证据支持；2) 识别行为健康专业参与不足问题；3) 为CMS网络充足性要求的实施提供数据支持；4) 公开数据工具支持地方决策。

title: Multivariate Time Series Classification With Online Expert Advice: An Application to Market Regimes
affiliations: and Credit Agricole Assurances

detail.title: Multivariate Time Series Classification With Online Expert Advice: An Application to Market Regimes
detail.abstract:
Market regimes are critical for tactical asset allocation and risk management, yet their subjective nature has prevented a consensus definition. This paper confronts this ambiguity by introducing a systematic framework for ex-ante cross-asset market regime identification, framing the challenge as a binary classification problem with highly imbalanced data. The framework is designed to be cross-asset, allowing for a flexible definition of the underlying risk factor and leveraging machine learning to incorporate diverse economic and financial features. 

A supervised learning pipeline is implemented on the equity risk factor using four distinct classifiers-Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and a multi-layer perceptron, trained on a rich dataset of macroeconomic and market variables. To enhance predictive stability and robustness, online convex optimization algorithms, such as Exponentially Weighted Average (EWA) and Online Gradient Descent (OGD), were employed to implement an expert-advice framework that dynamically updates the weights of each classifier based on its performance. 

The ensemble approach demonstrates a significant improvement over a traditional Hidden Markov Model (HMM) benchmark. The OGD ensemble model increased the F1-score from 51% to 80% and reduced the Brier score from 20% to 14%, showing a superior ability to classify market regimes and predict upcoming stress. Furthermore, SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) analysis provided deep interpretability, revealing that macroeconomic indicators-particularly inflation, are primary drivers of equity market regimes. The analysis also highlighted the unique ability of the neural network to identify upcoming stress signals. 

Overall, this paper proves that combining multiple machine learning models within an expert-advice scheme yields a robust, interpretable, and adaptable solution for market regime detection, offering valuable insights for tactical asset allocation, risk management and systematic hedging strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的前瞻性跨资产市场状态识别框架，将市场状态识别视为高度不平衡数据的二元分类问题。通过集成多种分类器并结合在线凸优化算法动态调整权重，显著提升了预测性能，优于传统隐马尔可夫模型。SHAP分析显示宏观经济指标（尤其是通胀）是股票市场状态的主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个稳健、可解释且适应性强的前瞻性跨资产市场状态识别框架？
AI.motivation: 市场状态对于战术资产配置和风险管理至关重要，但由于其主观性，缺乏共识定义。现有方法存在模糊性和局限性，需要系统性的框架来解决这一挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 市场状态识别作为二元分类问题；2. 机器学习集成方法；3. 在线凸优化算法（EWA、OGD）的专家建议框架；4. SHAP可解释性分析
AI.method: 1. 使用逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost和多层感知机四种分类器；2. 基于宏观经济和市场变量的丰富数据集；3. 采用EWA和OGD在线优化算法动态调整分类器权重；4. 与隐马尔可夫模型基准进行比较；5. 使用F1分数和Brier分数评估性能
AI.findings: 1. 集成方法显著优于传统HMM基准；2. OGD集成模型将F1分数从51%提升至80%，Brier分数从20%降至14%；3. SHAP分析显示宏观经济指标（特别是通胀）是股票市场状态的主要驱动因素；4. 神经网络在识别即将到来的压力信号方面具有独特能力
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了系统性的前瞻性跨资产市场状态识别框架；2. 将市场状态识别形式化为不平衡数据分类问题；3. 发展了基于在线优化的机器学习集成方法；4. 提供了市场状态识别的可解释性分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为战术资产配置提供更准确的市场状态预测；2. 改进风险管理决策；3. 支持系统性对冲策略；4. 提供可解释的市场状态驱动因素洞察；5. 构建了稳健且适应性的市场状态检测解决方案

title: The Fiscal Fracture: Property Tax Erosion and the Municipal Consequences of the Boomer Asset Mirage

detail.title: The Fiscal Fracture: Property Tax Erosion and the Municipal Consequences of the Boomer Asset Mirage
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Fiscal Channel, a third mechanism of the Cohort Asset Circularity Trap first described in the companion paper “The Boomer Asset Mirage” (Hanley, 2026). The Fiscal Channel identifies the pathway through which demographically-driven residential property value declines erode the property tax base that funds local government services and public education in communities where Baby Boomer homeownership is concentrated and working-age in-migration is insufficient to absorb the supply of housing released by boomer demographic exit.

Property taxes constitute between 70 and 75 percent of all local government tax revenue in the United States, including school district collections, and fund approximately 35 percent of national K–12 public education spending. According to U.S. Census Bureau data, state and local governments collected a record $797 billion in property tax revenue in 2024, representing 38 percent of all state and local tax collections. This revenue base is structurally vulnerable to a sustained, geographically concentrated decline in residential assessed values of the kind the Boomer Asset Mirage framework projects.

We document a self-reinforcing dynamic we term the Fiscal Circularity Loop: declining boomer-driven property values reduce municipal and school district tax bases; reduced revenues degrade public services and school quality; degraded services reduce community attractiveness to working-age households; reduced in-migration suppresses housing demand; and further demand suppression drives additional value declines. This loop mirrors the broader Cohort Asset Circularity Trap at the local government scale and represents one of the most durable and least-examined structural fiscal risks of the coming two decades.

Regional exposure to the Fiscal Channel is acute in northern New England, where Maine, Vermont, and New Hampshire hold the three highest median ages among all U.S. states. New Hampshire funds 70 percent of local public education through locally-retained property taxes and ranks dead last among all states in state contribution to public education at 28.8 percent, making its school finance system uniquely exposed to residential assessed value declines. Vermont’s K–12 enrollment has fallen 26 percent since 2003–2004, and the state’s rural school districts are already being described by regional media and state officials as experiencing a “death spiral” of enrollment loss, fixed-cost inflation, and property tax increases that accelerate out-migration — a live demonstration of the Fiscal Circularity Loop in early motion.

The paper extends the analysis to rural communities broadly, aging inner-ring suburbs, and coastal vacation markets where boomer-dominated second-home supply will simultaneously contract municipal tax bases and reduce the discretionary buyer demand that sustained those markets. Policy responses examined include regional tax base sharing, circuit breaker reforms, state equalization restructuring, and strategic land use and revitalization investment.

We find that no existing research integrates demographic cohort-exit dynamics, residential housing supply, and local government fiscal outcomes in a unified analytical framework. We call for a multi-disciplinary research program — initiated before the peak of the boomer demographic transition — to map regional fiscal exposure and model fiscal impacts under a range of supply and demand scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"财政渠道"作为"队列资产循环陷阱"的第三个机制，揭示了婴儿潮一代人口退出导致房产价值下降，进而侵蚀地方政府税收基础，形成"财政循环回路"的自我强化动态，对北部新英格兰等老龄化严重地区构成重大结构性财政风险。
AI.research_question: 婴儿潮一代人口退出如何通过"财政渠道"影响地方政府税收基础，形成自我强化的"财政循环回路"，以及哪些地区和政策应对措施最为关键？
AI.motivation: 美国地方政府70-75%的税收来自房产税，而婴儿潮一代的房产价值下降将严重侵蚀这一税收基础，但目前缺乏将人口退出动态、住房供应和地方政府财政结果整合的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"婴儿潮资产幻象"框架，提出"财政渠道"作为"队列资产循环陷阱"的第三个机制，构建"财政循环回路"理论模型，分析人口退出、房产价值、税收基础、公共服务质量、社区吸引力之间的循环关系。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与案例分析相结合，使用美国人口普查局数据（2024年房产税收入7970亿美元），以北部新英格兰地区（缅因州、佛蒙特州、新罕布什尔州）为典型案例进行深入分析。
AI.findings: 1）房产税占地方政府税收的38%，对人口退出导致的房产价值下降极为脆弱；2）"财政循环回路"已在新罕布什尔州和佛蒙特州显现；3）北部新英格兰地区风险最高，新罕布什尔州70%教育资金依赖地方房产税；4）佛蒙特州农村学区已出现"死亡螺旋"现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将人口队列退出动态、住房供应和地方政府财政结果整合到统一分析框架中，提出"财政渠道"和"财政循环回路"概念，填补了现有研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别高风险地区（老龄化社区、农村地区、内环郊区、沿海度假市场），提出区域税基共享、断路器改革、州级均衡结构调整、战略性土地利用和振兴投资等政策应对措施，呼吁建立多学科研究计划。

title: How to Save Lives Across the Globe: The Limits of Smoking Harm Education and the Promise of Market Driven Harm Reduction

detail.title: How to Save Lives Across the Globe: The Limits of Smoking Harm Education and the Promise of Market Driven Harm Reduction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no conflicts of interest to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: ICLE funded my work via my salary.

detail.abstract: Cigarette smoking remains one of the leading causes of preventable mortality worldwide, causing several million deaths annually, most of them in low-and middle-income countries. Although the health risks of smoking have been widely known for decades, smoking prevalence has declined slowly in many regions and has plateaued in others. This persistence cannot plausibly be explained primarily by lack of awareness. Instead, it reflects institutional and market constraints that limit smokers' ability to substitute combustible cigarettes with substantially lower-risk nicotine alternatives. This paper develops a conservative, market-constrained model of tobacco harm reduction (THR) that treats switching from cigarettes to non-combustible nicotine products as a function of legality, affordability, and supply readiness rather than education alone. Using global smoking-attributable mortality estimates and income-weighted measures of market feasibility, we estimate that feasible adoption of safer nicotine products could avert approximately 0.17-0.29 million deaths per year under a cautious switching scenario, 0.35-0.58 million under a moderate scenario, and 0.58-0.97 million under an ambitious but realistic scenario. Over a 40-year horizon with gradual adoption, these ranges correspond to roughly 6-10 million, 12-21 million, and 20-34 million deaths averted, respectively. Sensitivity analysis shows that plausible variation in the relative risk of non-combustible products has only a modest effect on outcomes. By contrast, regulatory and market constraints dominate results. The findings suggest that global tobacco control has largely exhausted the benefits of further education and now faces a structural failure to enable safer substitution at scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个市场约束模型，研究通过烟草减害策略（THR）让吸烟者转向非燃烧尼古丁产品，估计在不同情景下可避免数百万死亡，强调监管和市场约束而非教育是主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 在考虑市场约束（合法性、可负担性、供应准备度）而非仅教育的情况下，烟草减害策略（从香烟转向非燃烧尼古丁产品）在全球范围内能避免多少死亡？
AI.motivation: 吸烟仍是全球可预防死亡的主要原因，尽管健康风险广为人知，但吸烟率下降缓慢或停滞。这种持续性不能仅归因于缺乏意识，而是反映了限制吸烟者转向低风险尼古丁替代品的制度和市场约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 烟草减害（THR）理论，市场约束模型（将转向非燃烧产品视为合法性、可负担性和供应准备度的函数），而非仅依赖教育模型。
AI.method: 开发保守的市场约束模型，使用全球吸烟相关死亡率估计和收入加权的市场可行性指标，评估三种情景（谨慎、中等、雄心但现实）下的死亡避免潜力，并进行敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 在三种情景下，每年可避免死亡数分别为：0.17-0.29百万（谨慎）、0.35-0.58百万（中等）、0.58-0.97百万（雄心）。40年累计可避免死亡数分别为：6-10百万、12-21百万、20-34百万。敏感性分析显示非燃烧产品相对风险的变化对结果影响有限，而监管和市场约束主导结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个市场约束的烟草减害模型，将产品转向视为市场可行性（合法性、可负担性、供应）的函数，而非仅教育，挑战了传统烟草控制主要依赖教育的范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了烟草减害策略的潜在公共卫生效益，表明全球烟草控制已基本耗尽教育的效益，现在面临结构性障碍。为政策制定者提供了具体数据支持，强调需要解决监管和市场约束以实现大规模安全替代。

title: The Scale-up Pathway of China's Photovoltaic Industry: A Talent-Capital-Policy Coupling Framework
affiliations: and University of Cambridge

detail.title: The Scale-up Pathway of China's Photovoltaic Industry: A Talent-Capital-Policy Coupling Framework
detail.abstract: China's photovoltaic (PV) industry has grown from virtually nothing to dominating over 80% of global production capacity in less than two decades, whilst European and American industries have declined dramatically. This study proposes the "talent-capital-policy coupling mechanism" as a theoretical framework for explaining industrial scale-up success. We conceptualise "coupling" as the dynamic co-evolutionary interaction among elements generating synergistic effects beyond simple complementarity. Through comparative analysis of China, Europe, and America, we find that China's success results from effective temporal coupling of three elements: core talent's leading effect, broad patient capital, and policy continuity exemplified by Five-Year Plans. European and American industries failed through distinct coupling failures—breakdown through policy discontinuity in Europe, and non-formation through structural barriers in America—requiring distinct remediation strategies: trust rebuilding for Europe, structural reform for America.. This study further develops the "Industrial Scale-up Double Helix Model" as a visualisation framework with diagnostic power to identify element states and connection patterns. The contribution lies in revealing the "methodology" rather than merely the "outcome" of successful scale-up, providing theoretical guidance for emerging industry development.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了"人才-资本-政策耦合机制"理论框架，解释中国光伏产业在不到20年内从零发展到占据全球80%产能的成功，而欧美产业则衰退。研究发现中国的成功源于三要素的有效时间耦合，而欧美则因不同的耦合失败而衰落。
AI.research_question: 什么机制解释了中国光伏产业快速规模化成功而欧美产业衰退的现象？
AI.motivation: 中国光伏产业在不到20年内从零发展到占据全球80%以上产能，而欧美产业却急剧衰退，这一显著差异需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人才-资本-政策耦合机制（将耦合概念化为产生超越简单互补性的协同效应的动态协同进化互动）；工业规模化双螺旋模型（可视化框架，具有诊断能力识别要素状态和连接模式）。
AI.method: 对中国、欧洲和美国的比较分析。
AI.findings: 中国的成功源于三要素的有效时间耦合：核心人才的引领效应、广泛的耐心资本、以及以五年计划为体现的政策连续性。欧洲产业因政策不连续性导致耦合破裂而失败，美国产业因结构性障碍导致耦合未形成而失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了成功规模化的"方法论"而不仅仅是"结果"，为新兴产业发展提供理论指导；发展了具有诊断能力的工业规模化双螺旋模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲和美国提供了不同的补救策略：欧洲需要重建信任，美国需要结构性改革；为政策制定者和产业规划者提供了诊断工具。

title: Ecological MHT Practice: ESM Pathways to Precision Women's Health

detail.title: Ecological MHT Practice: ESM Pathways to Precision Women's Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract:
This article applies Evidence-Selective Medicine (ESM)—author's established six-level framework for institutional bias propagation—to dissect MHT breast cancer dogma origins: E3N paradox artifacts, Lancet 2019 synthetic dominance (>90% cohort), guideline citation cascades.

Evidence reanalysis:

  • E3N tE2-alone RR 1.29 artifactual (25% prior synthetics + surveillance bias); tE2+micronized progesterone RR 0.96 null

  • Norwegian cohort: oral E2+synthetic HR 2.42 (95% CI 2.31-2.54) vs transdermal ~1.2-1.5 (underpowered)

  • Competing risks: Bioidentical MHT 25-50% CV mortality reduction, 50% fracture prevention vs AI harms (CV events +7-12%, major FX +8-13%) in low-risk HR+/HER2- DCIS/stage 1 IDC

Novel paradigm: "Orphan endocrine insufficiency"—menopause requires systemic restoration across fragmented OBGYN-oncology-primary-geriatrics care.

Clinical toolkit: ESM checklist, COMET de-escalation (>95% 10yr survival, 44% surgery crossover), Canterbury-standard consent templates, absolute risk-benefit tables.

Timing: Post-FDA 2026 black-box removals (Nov 2025 announcement; Feb approvals: Prometrium, Bijuva, etc.)—translates regulatory shift into implementable precision care.

AI.tldr: 本文应用证据选择性医学（ESM）框架分析MHT（更年期激素治疗）与乳腺癌关系的教条起源，揭示E3N研究中的统计假象，提出"孤儿内分泌不足"新范式，强调需要跨专科的系统性激素恢复治疗。
AI.research_question: 更年期激素治疗（MHT）与乳腺癌风险之间的真实关系是什么？如何解释现有研究中的矛盾证据和统计假象？
AI.motivation: 现有关于MHT与乳腺癌风险的证据存在选择性偏差和制度性偏见传播，导致临床实践中的教条化认知，需要系统性分析证据选择过程并建立更精准的风险评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 证据选择性医学（ESM）六层次框架，用于分析制度性偏见的传播机制；竞争风险理论；孤儿内分泌不足概念。
AI.method: 对E3N研究和挪威队列研究进行证据再分析，识别统计假象和选择性偏差；应用ESM框架分析指南引用级联；开发临床工具包（ESM检查表、COMET降级方案等）。
AI.findings: 1. E3N研究中tE2单独使用RR 1.29是统计假象（25%先前合成激素+监测偏差），而tE2+微粒化孕酮RR 0.96为无效结果；2. 挪威队列显示口服E2+合成激素HR 2.42 vs 经皮~1.2-1.5；3. 生物同质MHT可降低25-50%心血管死亡风险和50%骨折风险，而AI治疗在低风险患者中增加7-12%心血管事件和8-13%主要骨折风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"孤儿内分泌不足"新范式，强调更年期需要跨专科的系统性激素恢复；建立ESM框架分析证据选择偏见；挑战MHT与乳腺癌关系的传统教条。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发临床工具包：ESM检查表、COMET降级方案（>95% 10年生存率）、坎特伯雷标准同意书模板、绝对风险-获益表；为FDA 2026年黑框警告移除后的精准医疗实施提供路线图。

title: The Household Impact of Generative AI: Evidence from Internet Browsing Behavior
affiliations: Stanford, UCLA Anderson School of Management and University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business - Finance and Business Economics Department

detail.title: The Household Impact of Generative AI: Evidence from Internet Browsing Behavior
detail.abstract: This paper studies the impact of generative AI on U.S. households' task allocation at home, using detailed Internet browsing data from a large sample of home devices between 2021 and 2024. Leveraging pre-ChatGPT browsing patterns, we measure households' exposure to ChatGPT and use it as an instrument for ChatGPT adoption during the post-release period. Our IV estimates show that adopting generative AI substantially increases leisure browsing on home devices while leaving time spent on productive digital tasks unchanged. To examine mechanisms, we infer the purpose of households' ChatGPT use from surrounding internet activity and find that households primarily employ it for productive non-market tasks. Together, these results suggest that generative AI frees up leisure time by raising the efficiency of productive digital activities. Interpreting these findings through a standard model of time allocation, we find that they imply economically large productivity gains from generative AI at home.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用美国家庭设备浏览数据（2021-2024年），发现采用生成式AI（ChatGPT）显著增加了家庭设备的休闲浏览时间，而不影响生产性数字任务时间。家庭主要将ChatGPT用于非市场生产性任务，表明生成式AI通过提高生产性数字活动效率来释放休闲时间。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何影响美国家庭在家庭环境中的任务分配和时间使用？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI技术（如ChatGPT）的快速发展对家庭生活和工作模式可能产生深远影响，但缺乏关于其在家庭环境中实际使用效果和影响的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准时间分配模型，分析家庭如何在生产性任务和休闲活动之间分配时间，以及技术如何通过提高效率影响这种分配。
AI.method: 使用美国家庭设备的大规模互联网浏览数据（2021-2024年），采用工具变量法：利用ChatGPT发布前的浏览模式作为工具变量来衡量家庭对ChatGPT的接触程度，以此作为ChatGPT采用的工具变量。
AI.findings:
1. 采用生成式AI显著增加了家庭设备的休闲浏览时间
2. 生产性数字任务时间保持不变
3. 家庭主要将ChatGPT用于非市场生产性任务
4. 生成式AI通过提高生产性数字活动效率来释放休闲时间
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为生成式AI在家庭环境中的影响提供了首个实证证据
2. 验证了标准时间分配模型在AI技术背景下的适用性
3. 揭示了生成式AI通过效率提升而非任务替代影响时间分配的机制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 量化了生成式AI在家庭环境中带来的生产效率提升
2. 为理解AI技术如何影响家庭生活和工作平衡提供依据
3. 为政策制定者评估AI技术的社会影响提供实证基础

title: Elevating Airline Performance with Data Analytics: A Strategic Guide to Key Performance Indicators
affiliations: and Islamic Azad University (IAU) - Garmsar Branch

detail.title: Elevating Airline Performance with Data Analytics: A Strategic Guide to Key Performance Indicators
detail.abstract: The accelerating pace of digital transformation within the airline industry necessitates a strategic reevaluation of data analytics practices, particularly the implementation of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for enhancing operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and financial performance. This study delves into the strategic significance of KPIs in the realm of airline data analytics, employing a mixed-methods research design that includes literature review, expert interviews, and case studies of leading airlines. The findings underscore the transformative impact of data analytics across operational, customer, and financial dimensions, highlighting the critical role of aligning KPIs with strategic goals, fostering a data-driven organizational culture, and adapting KPI strategies in response to evolving technological and market dynamics. Furthermore, the research presents actionable recommendations for Data Analysis Directors and airline executives, advocating for continuous adaptation and strategic refinement of data analytics practices. This study contributes to both theoretical and practical understandings of strategic data analytics in the airline industry, offering a comprehensive guide for leveraging KPIs to achieve competitive advantage and operational excellence. Future research avenues are suggested, including the exploration of emerging data technologies and the ethical use of data, to further enhance the strategic application of KPIs in the airline industry.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了航空公司数字化转型中关键绩效指标(KPIs)的战略重要性，通过混合方法研究发现数据分析和KPI对齐对运营效率、客户满意度和财务绩效的变革性影响，为航空业高管提供实用建议。
AI.research_question: 在航空业数字化转型加速的背景下，关键绩效指标(KPIs)在数据分析和战略实施中扮演什么角色？如何通过KPI战略提升运营效率、客户满意度和财务绩效？
AI.motivation: 航空业数字化转型步伐加快，需要重新评估数据分析实践，特别是KPI的实施对提升运营效率、客户满意度和财务绩效的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略数据分析理论、绩效管理理论、数字化转型理论、数据驱动组织文化理论。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：文献综述、专家访谈、领先航空公司的案例研究。
AI.findings: 数据分析在运营、客户和财务维度具有变革性影响；KPI与战略目标对齐至关重要；培育数据驱动组织文化是成功关键；需要根据技术和市场动态调整KPI策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了航空业战略数据分析的理论理解；提供了KPI战略实施的理论框架；拓展了数字化转型与绩效管理的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据分析总监和航空公司高管提供可操作建议；提供全面的KPI实施指南；帮助航空公司获得竞争优势和运营卓越；建议持续适应和战略完善的数据分析实践。

title: Territorial Acquisition after 1945: The Legal Significance of the Gwadar Transfer

detail.title: Territorial Acquisition after 1945: The Legal Significance of the Gwadar Transfer
detail.abstract: The prohibition of the use of force and the right of self-determination have reshaped the law of territorial cession, expansion and acquisition. Before the United Nations Charter was adopted, state practice permitted the exchange of territories on the basis of financial consideration. In the post-1945 international order, territorial acquisitions continued to be a part of state practice, and was achieved through good offices, military restraint and joint resource management. The port of Gwadar was transferred from Oman to Pakistan. As questions arise over the future of Greenland, I examine how Gwadar was transferred. Self-determination has become an important qualifying criterion for territorial cession, which was affirmed in the Chagos Advisory Opinion. I link the ICJ's Nottebohm decision on determining citizenship with the right of self-determination. The joint management of oil fields on the Saudi-Kuwaiti border provides a further legal and regulatory precedent for shared sovereignty of resources.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了联合国宪章后国际法中领土割让、扩张和获取的法律演变，重点分析了瓜达尔港从阿曼转移至巴基斯坦的案例，以及自决权如何成为领土割让的重要限定标准。
AI.research_question: 在联合国宪章禁止使用武力和自决权原则确立后，国际法中的领土割让、扩张和获取机制发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 随着格陵兰未来地位问题的出现，需要理解现代国际法中领土转移的合法机制，特别是自决权原则如何影响传统的领土获取方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 禁止使用武力原则（联合国宪章第2(4)条）；2) 自决权原则；3) 国际法院判例法（查戈斯咨询意见、诺特鲍姆案）；4) 共享主权理论
AI.method: 案例分析法：1) 瓜达尔港从阿曼到巴基斯坦的转移；2) 沙特-科威特边境油田联合管理；3) 国际法院判例分析；4) 历史实践比较（1945年前后）
AI.findings: 1) 1945年后领土获取继续存在，但通过斡旋、军事克制和联合资源管理等和平方式实现；2) 自决权已成为领土割让的重要限定标准；3) 诺特鲍姆案中确定公民身份的原则与自决权存在联系；4) 沙特-科威特边境油田联合管理为资源共享主权提供了法律先例
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了自决权作为现代领土割让核心标准的理论框架；2) 将公民身份确定原则与自决权联系起来；3) 发展了共享主权理论在资源管理中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为格陵兰等未来领土地位问题提供法律分析框架；2) 为和平解决领土争端提供实践模式（斡旋、联合管理）；3) 为国际法院和各国政府处理类似问题提供参考

title: Optimizing Astronomy Tourism Strategies A KPI-driven Approach to Enhancing Experience and Sustainability
affiliations: and Malayer University

detail.title: Optimizing Astronomy Tourism Strategies A KPI-driven Approach to Enhancing Experience and Sustainability
detail.abstract: The burgeoning niche of astronomy tourism presents a unique confluence of education, leisure, and environmental sustainability, poised for significant growth within the global tourism industry. This study explores the critical role of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in optimizing the management, promotion, and development of astronomy tourism experiences. Employing a mixed-methods approach that combines quantitative data analysis with qualitative stakeholder insights, the research identifies pivotal KPIs across three main areas: Tourist Satisfaction Rates, Partnership Effectiveness, and Sustainability Measures. Findings highlight the Net Promoter Score (NPS) and repeat visitation rates as essential metrics for assessing customer satisfaction, while the impact of strategic partnerships and sustainability initiatives underscores the need for collaborative and environmentally responsible practices. This paper discusses the alignment of these findings with existing theories in tourism management and suggests practical strategies for practitioners to leverage KPIs for enhancing tourism experiences, promoting sustainability, and improving operational efficiency. Acknowledging certain limitations, including the scope of data collection, the study proposes directions for future research, emphasizing the expansion of KPI scope, cross-cultural consumer behavior exploration, and the economic impact analysis of astronomy tourism. This research contributes to the theoretical and practical understanding of managing astronomy tourism, offering insights into leveraging KPIs for strategic advantage in this niche yet rapidly evolving sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨关键绩效指标(KPIs)在天文旅游管理、推广和发展中的优化作用，通过混合方法识别旅游满意度、合作伙伴效能和可持续性措施三大关键领域的KPIs，为天文旅游的战略管理提供理论和实践指导。
AI.research_question: 关键绩效指标(KPIs)如何优化天文旅游的管理、推广和发展？
AI.motivation: 天文旅游作为教育、休闲和环境可持续性融合的新兴细分市场，在全球旅游业中具有显著增长潜力，需要有效的管理工具来促进其发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅游管理理论、关键绩效指标理论、可持续发展理论、合作伙伴关系理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：结合定量数据分析和定性利益相关者洞察
AI.findings: 识别了三大关键领域的KPIs：1)旅游满意度率(包括净推荐值NPS和重复访问率)；2)合作伙伴效能；3)可持续性措施。战略合作伙伴关系和可持续性举措对天文旅游发展至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 将KPI理论应用于天文旅游这一新兴领域，丰富了旅游管理理论；为天文旅游的战略管理提供了理论框架；拓展了可持续旅游的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供实用的KPI策略来提升旅游体验、促进可持续性和改善运营效率；识别了关键绩效指标用于战略优势；提出了合作伙伴管理和可持续性实践的具体建议。

title: Spatial Heterogeneity in Pandemic Income Shocks and Safety Net Buffering: Evidence from California Labor Markets

detail.title: Spatial Heterogeneity in Pandemic Income Shocks and Safety Net Buffering: Evidence from California Labor Markets
detail.abstract: We examine how the COVID-19 pandemic affected household income across different types of California labor markets and assess the role of safety net programs in buffering income losses. Using IPUMS American Community Survey microdata from 2018-2023 linked to Labor Market Areas, we classify regions by pre-pandemic income levels and inequality. Our event study estimates document that nominal income gaps between high-cost and low-cost areas narrowed during the pandemic. However, when we adjust for local cost of living using the C2ER Cost of Living Index, a strikingly different picture emerges: low-income families in expensive metros like San Francisco and Los Angeles-who held a purchasing power advantage before COVID-ended up with lower real purchasing power than their rural counterparts by 2023. This reversal occurred because federal safety net programs distributed largely uniform dollar amounts regardless of local prices. A $1,400 stimulus check bought far more in Fresno than in San Francisco. Pre-trend analysis indicates that high-cost areas were already on a different income trajectory before the pandemic, so we interpret these patterns as descriptive evidence of spatial income dynamics rather than causal effects of COVID per se. Our findings suggest that geographically uniform benefit structures, while administratively simple, may inadvertently exacerbate spatial inequality in real terms.

AI.tldr: COVID-19疫情期间，加州不同劳动力市场的家庭收入变化呈现复杂图景：名义收入差距缩小，但考虑生活成本后，高成本地区低收入家庭的真实购买力反而低于农村地区，主要原因是联邦安全网项目按统一金额发放，未考虑地区价格差异。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情如何影响加州不同类型劳动力市场的家庭收入？安全网项目在缓冲收入损失方面发挥了什么作用？
AI.motivation: 理解疫情对不同地区家庭收入的异质性影响，评估安全网项目的空间分配效果，为政策设计提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间经济学、收入不平等理论、安全网政策评估、购买力平价概念。

title: The Speed of Corporate Cash Adjustment: Evidence from Labor Protection Laws
affiliations: Loughborough University - Loughborough Business School, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - School of Business,  and Loughborough University - Loughborough Business School

detail.title: The Speed of Corporate Cash Adjustment: Evidence from Labor Protection Laws
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of U.S. state-level labor protection laws on the speed of corporate cash adjustment. Exploiting the staggered adoption of wrongful discharge laws, we find that stronger labor protections significantly slow this adjustment, indicating greater frictions in rebalancing. The effect is asymmetric and particularly pronounced for cash-rich firms making downward adjustments. We identify three underlying mechanisms: intensified agency problems, heightened financial distress, and tightened financial constraints. Overall, our findings demonstrate that analyzing the speed of adjustment, rather than just cash levels, offers a more complete understanding of corporate cash policy.

detail.abstract: Creditors can sell their claims against bankrupt companies. Selling a claim allows a creditor to convert into cash a claim that may not be paid for years and is unlikely ever to be paid in full and allows the buyer to speculate on the claim value, in the hopes of paying less for the claim than the payout that will be distributed through the bankruptcy proceedings.  While claims trading is a common practice, there has not been a lot of case law on complications that can arise when the beneficial ownership of a claim changes via sale and assignment.  The article discusses some cases I worked on, including Enron's and Delphi Automotive, where there was heavy claims trading.

title: What is the Value of Censored Data? An Exact Analysis for the Data-driven Newsvendor
affiliations: and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: What is the Value of Censored Data? An Exact Analysis for the Data-driven Newsvendor
detail.abstract: We study the offline data-driven newsvendor problem with censored demand data. In contrast to prior works where demand is fully observed, we consider the setting where demand is censored at the inventory level and only sales are observed; sales match demand when there is sufficient inventory, and equal the available inventory otherwise. We provide a general procedure to compute the exact worst-case regret of classical data-driven inventory policies, evaluated over all demand distributions. Our main technical result shows that this infinite-dimensional, non-convex optimization problem can be reduced to a finite-dimensional one, enabling an exact characterization of the performance of policies for any sample size and censoring levels. We leverage this reduction to derive sharp insights on the achievable performance of standard inventory policies under demand censoring. In particular, our analysis of the Kaplan-Meier policy shows that while demand censoring fundamentally limits what can be learned from passive sales data, just a small amount of targeted exploration at high inventory levels can substantially improve worst-case guarantees, enabling near-optimal performance even under heavy censoring. In contrast, when the point-of-sale system does not record stockout events and only reports realized sales, a natural and commonly used approach is to treat sales as demand. Our results show that policies based on this sales-as-demand heuristic can suffer severe performance degradation as censored data accumulates, highlighting how the quality of point-of-sale information critically shapes what can, and cannot, be learned offline.

title: Revolution Versus Evolution in Corporation Law: The ALI’s Project and the Independent Director
affiliations: and George Mason University - Antonin Scalia Law School

detail.title: Revolution Versus Evolution in Corporation Law: The ALI’s Project and the Independent Director

Principles of Corporate Governance and Structure

publicationDetails.detailsText: GMU Working Paper in Economics Vol 52, No 4
publicationDetails.journalName: George Mason University Department of Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Some of the most controversial proposals of the American Law Institute’s Corporate Governance Project relate to changes in the structure and composition of the board of directors. The initial proposal of the Principles of Corporate Governance and Structure: Restatement and Recommendations mandated that a majority of the directors of large publicly held corporations be outsiders. This proposal was subsequently amended to recommend that corporations select such a board as a matter of corporate practice. The debate about the structure and composition of the board and board committees continues among legal commentators. The desirability of governmental or quasi-governmental interference with organizational behavior in a free market  and an absence of evidence about the effect independent directors have on corporate performance lie at the heart of the debate. This Article attempts to fill the evidentiary void.

Part I introduces the legal and economic issues of the corporate governance debate and of the ALI’s Project. Part II discusses the functions of the board of directors and demonstrates that the board occupies a central position in both legal and economic perspectives on corporate governance. Current economic analysis suggests that the board’s existence is consistent with the evolutionary success of the corporation as an organizational form. Legal scholars, on the other hand, view the board as a potentially valuable element of a comprehensive system of corporate governance but argue that the entrenched central management of large American corporations has not allowed boards to function in this capacity. The controversy over the current role and efficacy of the board suggests the need for empirical analysis. 

Part III presents empirical evidence concerning the changing composition of the corporate board and the effect of such changes on corporate performance. Board independence increased during the 1970s as boards were staffed voluntarily by directors who would meet the ALI’s standard for independence. Apparently, the evolution occurred because senior management recognized a positive relationship between board independence and improved financial performance. Evidence indicates, however, that the revolutionary and intrusive changes advocated by some commentators could easily threaten corporate survival and that the present optimal degree of independence is well below the level proposed by the ALI’s Project. Part IV discusses the policy implications of this evidence.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest regarding the publication of this paper.

detail.abstract:
This paper proposes **Governance Engineering**, a fundamental reconstruction of regional resource management based on the physical laws of thermodynamics and fluid dynamics. We expose the **"Vacuum Fallacy"** in contemporary growth models—the assumption that information processing and governance can occur without physical cost. By redefining governance as "Social Computation," we apply **Landauer’s Principle** to demonstrate that any increase in intelligence (A) or system complexity results in a non-linear explosion of management entropy. 

By analyzing municipal financial settlements as thermodynamic sensor data, we provide empirical proof that the current centralized "Tokyo System" has reached its **"Heat Death"** limit, manifesting as a structural configuration of high-positive divergence (∇·J ≫ 0). To resolve this metabolic failure, we introduce the **G-Cart (Governance Cart) Protocol**, an algorithmic fluid control system that enforces **Impedance Matching** and **Mesh Refinement**. Central to this architecture is the **Physical Bill of Exchange (P-Bill)**, an autonomous negotiable instrument minted via verifiable physical telemetry (D_mass, D_energy, D_space), which architecturally prevents the desynchronization of digital signals and physical mass. This work moves beyond political rhetoric to offer an engineered path toward a sustainable, high-velocity regional survival circuit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"治理工程学"，基于热力学和流体动力学原理重构区域资源管理，揭示当前增长模型中的"真空谬误"，证明智能增长导致管理熵非线性爆炸，并提出G-Cart协议和物理交换票据作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何基于物理定律（热力学和流体动力学）重构区域资源治理系统，解决当前集中式治理系统的"热寂"极限问题？
AI.motivation: 当前区域治理模型存在"真空谬误"，假设信息处理和治理可以无物理成本进行，导致集中式系统（如东京系统）达到"热寂"极限，表现为高正散度结构配置，需要基于物理定律的工程化解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 热力学和流体动力学原理；2. 兰道尔原理（信息处理的最小能耗）；3. 治理作为"社会计算"的概念重构；4. 真空谬误理论；5. 阻抗匹配和网格细化理论。
AI.method: 1. 将市政财务结算数据作为热力学传感器数据分析；2. 应用兰道尔原理分析智能增长与管理熵的关系；3. 设计G-Cart协议作为算法流体控制系统；4. 引入物理交换票据（P-Bill）作为基于可验证物理遥测的自主可转让工具。
AI.findings: 1. 当前集中式"东京系统"已达到"热寂"极限，表现为高正散度（∇·J ≫ 0）的结构配置；2. 任何智能（A）或系统复杂度的增加都会导致管理熵的非线性爆炸；3. 数字信号与物理质量的脱节是系统失效的核心问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"治理工程学"新范式；2. 揭示"真空谬误"理论；3. 将治理重构为"社会计算"；4. 将兰道尔原理应用于治理系统分析；5. 提出基于物理定律的治理系统设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发G-Cart协议作为算法流体控制系统；2. 引入物理交换票据（P-Bill）防止数字与物理脱节；3. 提供可实施的工程化路径，实现可持续、高速度的区域生存电路；4. 超越政治修辞，提供基于物理定律的具体解决方案。

title: Before Strategy: Governance Behaviour as the Endogenous Precursor to Outcome Volatility A Longitudinal Analysis of the S&P 500 (2015-2024)

detail.title: Before Strategy: Governance Behaviour as the Endogenous Precursor to Outcome Volatility A Longitudinal Analysis of the S&P 500 (2015-2024)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am an independent researcher and author specializing in the area of quantifying organizational capability in the Governance of Strategy using Feature Engineering. I hereby declare that I have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. Specifically, I confirm that I do not have any personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have, or could be perceived to have, influenced the study design, data collection, analysis, or interpretation of the findings presented herein.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study relies exclusively on the analysis of secondary corporate data, publicly available financial disclosures, and anonymized case studies, and does not involve human participants or interventions.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was entirely self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Standard financial analysis typically treats corporate governance as a compliance attribute or a lagging indicator of firm performance. This paper proposes a structural re-definition, positing governance as a behavioural system comprising two independent variables: Value Creation Intent (VCI) and Governance Capability (Agility). By operationalizing these constructs through "Governance Feature Engineering"-a method of quantifying leadership behaviour-and mapping the S&P 500 over a tenyear period (2015-2024), this research demonstrates that governance behaviour predicts outcome volatility and strategic failure well before financial ratios deteriorate. The study isolates the "COVID Stress Test" (2020-2022), revealing a significant capital migration from "Convergence" (High Intent/High Agility) to "Overreach" (High Intent/Low Agility). The findings confirm that outcome dispersion is endogenous to governance behaviour; specifically, "Overreach" firms exhibited volatility levels 20x higher than their "Convergent" peers during the 2022 market correction, despite reporting identical median returns. This framework offers a diagnostic tool to identify institutional fragility during periods of liquidity-driven growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究重新定义公司治理为行为系统，包含价值创造意图和治理敏捷性两个变量，通过治理特征工程方法量化领导行为，发现治理行为能提前预测结果波动和战略失败，特别是在COVID压力测试期间，资本从"收敛型"向"过度扩张型"迁移，后者波动性高出20倍。
AI.research_question: 公司治理行为（价值创造意图和治理敏捷性）如何预测企业结果波动和战略失败？
AI.motivation: 传统财务分析将公司治理视为合规属性或滞后绩效指标，缺乏对治理作为行为系统的理解，无法提前预测企业风险和战略失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 公司治理作为行为系统理论；2. 价值创造意图（VCI）和治理敏捷性（Agility）双变量框架；3. 治理特征工程方法；4. 企业行为与结果波动内生关系理论。
AI.method: 治理特征工程方法量化领导行为，对S&P 500指数公司进行十年期（2015-2024）映射分析，特别隔离COVID压力测试（2020-2022）作为自然实验。
AI.findings: 1. 治理行为能提前预测结果波动和战略失败；2. COVID期间资本从"收敛型"（高意图/高敏捷）向"过度扩张型"（高意图/低敏捷）迁移；3. "过度扩张型"公司在2022年市场调整期间波动性比"收敛型"高20倍，尽管中位数回报相同；4. 结果分散是治理行为的内生结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出公司治理作为行为系统的新理论框架；2. 建立价值创造意图和治理敏捷性的操作化定义；3. 证明治理行为与结果波动的内生关系；4. 发展治理特征工程方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供诊断工具识别流动性驱动增长期间的制度脆弱性；2. 帮助投资者提前识别高风险企业；3. 为企业治理改进提供行为导向框架；4. 为监管机构提供早期风险预警系统。

title: Understanding the Interplay of Formal Rules and Informal Norms in Women's Academic Career Advancement

detail.title: Understanding the Interplay of Formal Rules and Informal Norms in Women's Academic Career Advancement

contentType.other: Abridged version of a chapter from PhD dissertation

detail.abstract: This article examines the dynamic interplay of formal and informal institutions in shaping women's advancement to academic leadership. Drawing on in-depth interviews with 17 women in senior academic leadership positions across four Nigerian federal universities, this study explores how formal promotion processes and informal norms interact to influence women's career trajectories. The study focuses on women's lived experiences of promotion, from entry-level academic cadre to academic leadership positions, to uncover where along the pipeline they encounter ease or difficulty, and why. It particularly explores the extent informal institutions subvert the intent of formal policies, potentially undermining women's advancement, and in what ways do women respond or adapt to these conditions? The Nigerian case is used as a lens to illuminate broader patterns that resonate globally, while also retaining context-specific insights. Comparisons are drawn between universities with explicit gender equality policies and those without, to assess whether a formal commitment to gender equity makes a tangible difference in practice. By integrating a Feminist Institutionalist perspective (FI) with a Feminist Critical Discourse Analysis (FCDA), the study provides a nuanced account of how power and gender operate within academic institutions. The analysis highlights key informal mechanisms such as gendered bias in promotion evaluations, patronage networks, and normative expectations around gender roles, that influence promotion outcomes. It also showcases the strategies of resistance that women develop and how they navigate these resistances, illustrating a complementary interplay of formal and informal institutions. Ultimately, this article argues that meaningful progress toward gender equity in academia requires not only robust formal policies but also cultural and institutional change that dismantles adverse informal norms. The findings contribute to debates on gender and higher education by shedding light on how hidden institutional dynamics and 'rules of the game' continue to affect women's leadership prospects, and what this implies for policy and practice in both Nigerian academia and globally.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了尼日利亚大学中正式与非正式制度如何互动影响女性晋升学术领导职位，发现非正式规范（如性别偏见、庇护网络）常常削弱正式性别平等政策的效果，女性通过多种策略应对这些障碍。
AI.research_question: 正式晋升程序与非正式规范如何互动影响女性学术职业发展轨迹？非正式制度在多大程度上削弱正式政策的意图？女性如何应对这些条件？
AI.motivation: 理解学术机构中性别平等的障碍，特别是正式政策与非正式实践之间的差距，为全球高等教育中的性别平等提供洞见。
AI.theoretical_framework: 女性主义制度主义（FI）与女性主义批判话语分析（FCDA）相结合的理论框架。
AI.method: 对尼日利亚四所联邦大学17位女性高级学术领导进行深度访谈的质性研究，比较有明确性别平等政策与无此类政策的大学。
AI.findings: 非正式机制（晋升评估中的性别偏见、庇护网络、性别角色规范期望）显著影响晋升结果；女性发展出多种抵抗策略；正式性别平等政策在实践中常被非正式规范削弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合FI与FCDA框架，提供学术机构中权力与性别运作的细致分析；揭示正式与非正式制度的互补性互动；扩展对"游戏规则"如何影响女性领导前景的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出实现学术性别平等需要同时加强正式政策和改变不利的非正式规范；为尼日利亚及全球高等教育机构提供政策建议；强调文化变革的重要性。

title: Optimizing Agritourism Strategies: A KPI-Driven Approach to Enhancing Visitor Experience and Sustainability
affiliations: and Islamic Azad University (IAU) - Central Tehran Branch

detail.title: Optimizing Agritourism Strategies: A KPI-Driven Approach to Enhancing Visitor Experience and Sustainability
detail.abstract: This study delves into the strategic utilization of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in agritourism, a sector at the nexus of agriculture and tourism offering unique, immersive experiences that connect visitors with rural life, agriculture, and sustainability practices. Amidst the growing demand for sustainable and authentic travel experiences, this research aims to identify, analyze, and evaluate how specific KPIs can enhance the effectiveness of agritourism strategies, focusing on optimizing visitor experience, financial performance, operational efficiency, and sustainability. Employing a mixedmethods research design, the study combines qualitative analyses of case studies and expert interviews with quantitative evaluation of performance data across several agritourism operations. The findings highlight the critical role of KPIs in guiding strategic decision-making, with particular emphasis on customer experience metrics, financial indicators, operational metrics, and sustainability measures. The research illustrates that a KPI-driven approach is indispensable for achieving strategic agility, enhancing visitor satisfaction, and promoting sustainable practices within agritourism. Furthermore, it provides actionable insights for agritourism operators on leveraging technology for data analysis, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and tailoring KPIs to specific business objectives. Conclusively, the study not only contributes to the theoretical literature on agritourism and strategic management but also offers practical guidelines for agritourism operators seeking to navigate the complexities of integrating agriculture and tourism successfully.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了关键绩效指标（KPIs）在农业旅游中的战略应用，通过混合研究方法发现KPIs对提升游客体验、财务绩效、运营效率和可持续性具有关键作用，为农业旅游经营者提供了实用的战略指导。
AI.research_question: 特定的关键绩效指标（KPIs）如何提升农业旅游战略的有效性，特别是在优化游客体验、财务绩效、运营效率和可持续性方面？
AI.motivation: 随着对可持续和真实旅行体验需求的增长，农业旅游作为连接农业与旅游的独特领域，需要有效的战略工具来应对挑战并抓住机遇。KPIs作为战略管理工具，在农业旅游中的应用研究相对缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略管理理论、绩效管理理论、农业旅游理论、可持续旅游理论、体验经济理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：结合案例研究的定性分析和专家访谈，以及对多个农业旅游运营绩效数据的定量评估
AI.findings: KPIs在指导战略决策中发挥关键作用，特别是客户体验指标、财务指标、运营指标和可持续性指标。KPI驱动的方法对于实现战略敏捷性、提升游客满意度和促进可持续实践至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了农业旅游和战略管理理论文献，为KPIs在农业旅游领域的应用提供了理论框架，连接了农业、旅游和可持续性三个领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业旅游经营者提供实用指南：如何利用技术进行数据分析、培养持续改进文化、根据具体业务目标定制KPIs，以及成功整合农业与旅游的复杂性。

title: Coercive Resource Diplomacy: Modeling China's Rare Earth Export Control Escalation Dynamics And Western Deterrence Options

detail.title: Coercive Resource Diplomacy: Modeling China's Rare Earth Export Control Escalation Dynamics And Western Deterrence Options

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author has no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Only secondary data used. No human subjects. Approval granted.
declarations.funderStatement: ICL Institute, New Jersey, USA

detail.abstract: This study investigates China's use of rare earth element (REE) export controls as instruments of coercive resource diplomacy and evaluates Western deterrence options through a mixed-methods research design integrating event study analysis, process-tracing case studies, and game-theoretic modeling. China's dominance over the rare earth supply chain—controlling approximately 60% of global mining and 90% of processing capacity—has created strategic vulnerabilities for Western nations dependent on these critical minerals for defense systems, clean energy technologies, and advanced manufacturing. Drawing on economic statecraft theory (Baldwin, 1985; Drezner, 2003), deterrence frameworks (Schelling, 1966; Morgan, 2003), and weaponized interdependence literature (Farrell & Newman, 2019), this research examines four empirical cases: the 2010 Japan embargo, the 2012-2014 WTO dispute period, the 2023-2025 graduated export control escalation, and the November 2025 diplomatic pause. Quantitative analysis of 25 policy events reveals significant cumulative abnormal returns for Western rare earth producers, including +29.36% for MP Materials following October 2025 MOFCOM controls and -39.11% for Lynas Rare Earths following diplomatic resolution announcements. Trade flow analysis documents $9.9 billion in Chinese rare earth exports to the United States, Japan, and European Union between 2010 and 2024, with Japan representing the largest import partner. Price volatility analysis indicates highest market disruption during the 2011-2014 WTO dispute period, with strong correlation (r = 0.85) between trade values and strategic rare earth prices. All four research hypotheses receive empirical support, demonstrating that export controls generate significant market reactions, escalation follows predictable patterns, Western resilience moderates coercion effectiveness, and diplomatic resolutions impact market expectations. The findings contribute to economic statecraft theory by documenting the "coercion paradox" whereby restrictions accelerate Western diversification efforts, ultimately undermining long-term Chinese leverage. Policy implications address optimal deterrence configurations for policymakers, industry stakeholders, and alliance coordination mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨中国如何利用稀土出口管制作为胁迫性资源外交工具，并评估西方的威慑选项。通过混合研究方法发现，中国的稀土控制创造了西方国家的战略脆弱性，但出口管制反而加速了西方多元化努力，削弱了中国长期影响力。
AI.research_question: 中国如何利用稀土出口管制作为胁迫性资源外交工具？西方有哪些有效的威慑选项？
AI.motivation: 中国在稀土供应链中占据主导地位（控制全球约60%的采矿和90%的加工能力），这为依赖这些关键矿物的西方国家创造了战略脆弱性，需要研究如何应对这种资源胁迫。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济治国理论（Baldwin, 1985; Drezner, 2003）、威慑框架（Schelling, 1966; Morgan, 2003）和武器化相互依存理论（Farrell & Newman, 2019）。
AI.method: 混合研究方法设计，整合事件研究分析、过程追踪案例研究和博弈论建模。分析了四个实证案例：2010年对日本禁运、2012-2014年WTO争端期、2023-2025年渐进式出口管制升级、2025年11月外交暂停。
AI.findings: 1) 出口管制产生显著市场反应（MP Materials在2025年10月管制后累计异常回报+29.36%）；2) 升级遵循可预测模式；3) 西方韧性调节胁迫有效性；4) 外交解决方案影响市场预期。发现"胁迫悖论"：限制反而加速西方多元化努力，削弱中国长期影响力。
AI.theory_contributions: 对经济治国理论的贡献：记录了"胁迫悖论"，即出口限制加速西方多元化努力，最终削弱长期胁迫能力。丰富了武器化相互依存理论在资源外交中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、行业利益相关者和联盟协调机制提供最优威慑配置建议。帮助西方制定应对中国稀土胁迫的有效策略，促进供应链多元化。

title: Beyond Competitive Advantage: Large Understanding Models, Symbiotic Strategy, and a New Paradigm in Strategic Management

detail.title: Beyond Competitive Advantage: Large Understanding Models, Symbiotic Strategy, and a New Paradigm in Strategic Management
detail.abstract: Contemporary strategic thinking is at a crossroads. The classical paradigm of sustainable competitive advantage – long predicated on protected market positions and firm-specific resources – is increasingly challenged by an environment of blurring boundaries, digital interconnectivity, and rapid innovation. This conceptual paper critically examines why the canonical theory of competitive advantage has become epistemologically outdated in the 21st century. In its place, we propose a new paradigm centered on Large Understanding Models (LUMs) as a transformative lens for strategic management, organizational decision science, and AI-informed leadership theory. LUMs – introduced in the author’s prior work – integrate semantic comprehension, causal reasoning, and contextual intelligence within AI systems, enabling organizations to interpret complexity and make decisions with unprecedented depth. We frame LUMs as an original theoretical contribution, already being operationalized through the EU-based project Predictores.ai, thus bridging theory and practice. Further, drawing on Professor Chen Chunhua’s symbiotic strategy concept – encapsulated in her call to move from “closed fortresses” to “symbiotic interfaces” – we synthesize how a symbiotic, ecosystem-based view of strategy harmonizes with LUM-driven intelligence. The result is a novel perspective in which firms leverage understanding (both human and machine) as the central source of strategic value, rather than static competitive positions. We outline how LUMs reshape the interpretive capacity of organizations, enhance decision-making processes, and demand new leadership models that blend human judgment with AI co-analysis. This paper is purely theoretical, offering a rigorous, interdisciplinary framework that provocatively rethinks strategy in the AI era. We conclude by highlighting implications for future research and practice, positing that understanding-based strategy may eclipse traditional competitive advantage as the guiding logic of organizational success.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用大型理解模型（LUMs）作为战略管理新范式，取代传统的可持续竞争优势理论，强调在AI时代理解能力（而非静态竞争地位）成为战略价值核心来源。
AI.research_question: 为什么经典的竞争优势理论在21世纪变得过时？大型理解模型（LUMs）如何为战略管理、组织决策科学和AI驱动的领导力理论提供新的范式？
AI.motivation: 传统可持续竞争优势理论基于受保护的市场地位和公司特定资源，但在边界模糊、数字互联和快速创新的环境中日益受到挑战，需要新的战略思维框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 大型理解模型（LUMs）理论：整合语义理解、因果推理和情境智能的AI系统；2. 陈春花教授的共生战略概念：从"封闭堡垒"转向"共生界面"；3. 生态系统战略观；4. 理解型战略作为战略价值核心来源。
AI.method: 纯理论性概念论文，采用批判性分析和理论构建方法，通过跨学科框架重新思考AI时代的战略。
AI.findings: 1. LUMs重塑组织的解释能力；2. 增强决策过程；3. 需要融合人类判断与AI协同分析的新领导力模型；4. 理解型战略可能取代传统竞争优势成为组织成功的指导逻辑。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出LUMs作为战略管理新理论贡献；2. 将共生战略概念与LUM驱动的智能相结合；3. 建立理解型战略的新视角；4. 提供跨学科的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. LUMs已在欧盟项目Predictores.ai中操作化；2. 为组织如何利用理解能力创造战略价值提供指导；3. 为AI时代的领导力发展提供方向；4. 连接理论与实践。

title: Which Companies are Ahead in Frontier Innovation on Critical Technologies? Comparing China, The European Union and the United States
affiliations: Bruegel, Bruegel and Bruegel

detail.title: Which Companies are Ahead in Frontier Innovation on Critical Technologies? Comparing China, The European Union and the United States
detail.abstract: Competition in critical technologies is attracting increasing attention not only because of the foundational nature of these technologies for other types of innovation, but also because of their role in the United States national security strategy. In this paper, we look into which entities in China, the European Union and the US innovate at the technology frontier in the three most important critical technologies-artificial intelligence, quantum computing and semiconductors-based on identification of the most radical novel patents in these technologies and their subsectors. Working with these pathbreaking patents, we look into the origin of the companies that file the largest numbers of them. US innovators dominate the innovation frontier for quantum computing and, to a lesser extent, AI, with Chinese innovators doing better in semiconductors. European innovators lag in all, but perform relatively better in quantum computing, in which they rank similarly to Chinese innovators. Furthermore, the innovation ecosystem is quite different across geographies. In the US, tech companies top the rankings of critical novelties and are highly concentrated: as many as three companies are in the top rankings of all of the three critical technologies. Frontier innovators in the field in which the EU competes most equally-quantum-are mostly research centres and not companies. China lies somewhat in between in all three domains.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了中美欧在人工智能、量子计算和半导体三大关键技术领域的创新前沿表现，发现美国在量子计算和AI领域领先，中国在半导体领域表现较好，欧洲整体落后但量子计算相对较强。创新生态系统存在显著地域差异：美国以高度集中的科技公司主导，欧洲以研究中心为主，中国则介于两者之间。
AI.research_question: 中美欧三大经济体在人工智能、量子计算和半导体等关键技术领域的创新前沿表现如何？不同地区的创新生态系统有何差异？
AI.motivation: 关键技术竞争日益受到关注，因为这些技术不仅是其他创新的基础，还在美国国家安全战略中扮演重要角色。了解不同经济体在关键技术前沿的创新表现和生态系统差异具有重要政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术创新前沿理论、国家创新系统理论和专利分析框架，关注激进创新（radical novelty）的识别和比较。
AI.method: 通过识别人工智能、量子计算和半导体领域最具突破性的新颖专利（radical novel patents），分析这些前沿专利的申请主体及其地域分布，比较不同经济体的创新表现和生态系统特征。
AI.findings: 1. 美国在量子计算和AI创新前沿占据主导地位，中国在半导体领域表现较好，欧洲整体落后但在量子计算领域相对较强（与中国相当）。2. 创新生态系统存在显著地域差异：美国由高度集中的科技公司主导（三家公司同时在三大技术领域排名前列）；欧洲在量子计算领域以研究中心为主；中国在三个领域都处于中间状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了关键技术领域创新前沿的跨国比较框架。2. 揭示了不同经济体创新生态系统的结构性差异。3. 强调了激进创新（radical novelty）作为衡量技术前沿的重要指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关键技术竞争格局的实证依据。2. 帮助企业了解不同技术领域的创新动态和竞争对手。3. 为投资决策提供参考，识别关键技术领域的创新热点和领先者。

title: How Similar is the Chinese Economy to that of Japan after the Bubble Burst?
affiliations: Bruegel

detail.title: How Similar is the Chinese Economy to that of Japan after the Bubble Burst?
detail.abstract:
Since the burst of China’s real estate sector bubble in mid2021, there is a growing concern that the Chinese economy could end up like that of Japan in the early 1990s. Some patterns are strikingly similar, such as the sharp deceleration in fixed asset investment, especially in the housing market. 

Both countries have long suffered from low private consumption, especially when compared with the rest of the world, and an excessively high saving ratio. Their initial policy responses to the growth challenges are also similar since both China and Japan were initially hesitant to ease monetary and fiscal policies after the collapse of the bubble. Instead, they chose to expand supply, in particular manufacturing, with an eye on external demand. The result of such policies is protracted trade surpluses, which did not help mitigate the consequences of the burst of the bubble. On the contrary, they only fed deflationary pressures. 

China seems to be following Japan in terms of seeking expansion of its overseas assets although with some differences. For Japan, offshoring or production to China and Southeast Asia, through greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) was crucial in reducing its production costs and ensuring continued access to Western markets. The strategy also helped Japan circumventing protectionist measures, especially from the US. China has also stepped up its outbound investment, as Japan did in the 1980s although the focus has been a bit different, namely acquiring resources and building infrastructure through the Belt and Road Initiative. Another similarity to maintain supply has been the quest to move up the ladder, with a surge in expenditure in research and development (R&D). 

Notwithstanding the similarities, there are also crucial differences in China’s and Japan’s structural situation. Some should make China’s case potentially better off, but others push in the opposite direction. Starting with the latter, China’s macroeconomic imbalances, in particularly the excess saving and low private consumption, are much larger than that were in Japan and. China's reliance on manufacturing is also significantly larger, which has led to a larger share of global exports. 

Moreover, the wave of protectionism now is much stronger than it was when Japan was pushing its manufacturing in the 1980s. China will find it harder to protect itself from protectionism by offshoring its manufacturing capacity through greenfield investment than Japan did, especially because its income per capita are lower than those of Japan when it moved its production overseas in the 1980s. The positive angle for China, compared to Japan, is its geopolitical power with the Global South and its ability to become self-reliant technologically. This also offers options for China to create its own ecosystem if the US keeps containing China.

All in all, China seems to be heading to similar growth trajectory as Japan did in the past. However, some differences also exist that could yield different outcomes, making it important to closely monitor the situation.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了中国房地产泡沫破裂后与日本1990年代泡沫破裂后的经济表现，分析了两国在政策应对、经济结构、外部环境等方面的相似性与差异性，探讨了中国是否会重蹈日本覆辙。
AI.research_question: 中国在房地产泡沫破裂后是否会重蹈日本1990年代"失去的十年"的覆辙？两国在应对经济下行时的政策选择、经济结构特征及外部环境有何异同？
AI.motivation: 自2021年中国房地产泡沫破裂以来，人们担心中国经济可能重蹈日本1990年代的覆辙。两国在固定投资减速、私人消费低迷、高储蓄率等方面存在惊人相似性，但也有一些关键差异可能影响最终结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 泡沫经济后遗症理论；2. 资产负债表衰退理论；3. 出口导向型增长模式的局限性；4. 保护主义对全球价值链的影响；5. 地缘政治经济学
AI.method: 比较案例分析法，通过历史对比分析中国与日本在房地产泡沫破裂后的经济表现、政策应对、结构特征和外部环境，识别相似性与差异性。
AI.findings:
相似性：1) 两国都面临固定投资急剧减速；2) 私人消费长期低迷、储蓄率过高；3) 泡沫破裂后初期都犹豫采取宽松政策；4) 都选择扩大制造业供应并依赖外部需求；5) 都通过海外投资寻求扩张。
差异性：1) 中国的宏观经济失衡更严重；2) 对制造业依赖度更高；3) 当前保护主义浪潮更强；4) 中国人均收入较低限制海外转移能力；5) 中国在"全球南方"的地缘政治影响力更强；6) 中国技术自主能力更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了泡沫经济后遗症的比较研究框架；2. 识别了不同历史时期保护主义对出口导向型经济的影响差异；3. 提出了地缘政治因素在应对经济下行中的调节作用；4. 分析了技术自主能力对经济韧性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为中国政策制定者提供日本经验教训的参考；2. 警示过度依赖制造业和外部需求的风险；3. 强调内需扩张和技术自主的重要性；4. 为投资者评估中国经济前景提供分析框架；5. 指出在保护主义环境下海外投资策略需要调整。

title: Deconstructing Democratic Imperial Structures in African History
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology

detail.title: Deconstructing Democratic Imperial Structures in African History

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest applies to this study
declarations.ethicsApproval: The sources applied in this study are open access, and readily available on the Open access Platforms with no risk and pose no harm to organizations and humans.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding is tied to this research study

detail.abstract:
This study explores the historical and contemporary implications of democratic imperial structures in Africa. Researchers adopted a structured approach, gathering and analysing qualitative data from a wealth of online literature sources and expert opinions. They meticulously selected 28 peer-reviewed articles spanning from 1958 to 2023, each discussing the Deconstructing Democratic Imperial Structures in African History. The data revealed the limitations of the growth of uncertainty to govern institutions in African countries. The systematic approach ultimately provided valuable insights into the struggles and challenges faced by the Deconstructing Democratic Imperial Structures in African History. By deconstructing the concept of democratic imperialism, the study highlights the ways in which external influences ranging from colonial rule to modern neo-colonial practices have shaped political institutions, social hierarchies, and economic systems in African nations. The research identifies three key themes: the legacy of colonial governance, the role of international organisations in promoting democratic values, and the impact of local resistance movements. Each theme underscores the tension between imposed democratic ideals and the realities of governance in diverse cultural contexts. Furthermore, the paper examines case studies from various African countries, illustrating how historical narratives are crucial for understanding current political challenges faced by many nations.

Ultimately, this study argues that a comprehensive understanding of Africa’s democratic trajectory necessitates a critical engagement with its imperial past. By incorporating voices from diverse scholarly perspectives, this research contributes to a nuanced discourse on democracy, sovereignty, and identity in Africa. The findings advocate for a re-evaluation of democratic frameworks that genuinely reflect the aspirations of African societies, thereby fostering more equitable and inclusive governance models.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析1958-2023年的28篇同行评议文献，解构非洲历史中的民主帝国主义结构，揭示了外部影响如何塑造非洲政治制度、社会等级和经济体系，并提出了重新评估民主框架的必要性。
AI.research_question: 民主帝国主义结构在非洲历史中的历史与当代影响是什么？如何通过解构这一概念来理解非洲民主发展的轨迹？
AI.motivation: 理解非洲国家在民主发展过程中面临的挑战，特别是外部影响（从殖民统治到现代新殖民实践）如何塑造其政治制度、社会结构和经济体系，从而为更公平包容的治理模式提供见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主帝国主义理论、后殖民理论、批判民主理论、新殖民主义理论，以及关于主权、身份和治理的学术框架。
AI.method: 采用结构化定性研究方法，收集和分析在线文献资料和专家意见，系统筛选了1958年至2023年间的28篇同行评议文章，进行主题分析和案例研究。
AI.findings: 研究揭示了三个关键主题：1）殖民治理的遗产；2）国际组织在推广民主价值观中的作用；3）地方抵抗运动的影响。这些主题凸显了强加的民主理想与多元文化背景下治理现实之间的张力，并表明非洲国家治理机构在不确定性增长方面存在局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）深化了对民主帝国主义概念的解构；2）为理解非洲民主发展提供了历史视角；3）丰富了关于民主、主权和身份的理论讨论；4）整合了多元学术观点，形成了更细致的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了重新评估民主框架的见解；2）倡导建立更公平包容的治理模式；3）通过案例研究为具体国家提供参考；4）促进对非洲社会真正愿望的民主制度的反思。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Thomas, T. (2026). Post-Pandemic Business Strategies for California Small Firms, 2020–2025. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18663576

detail.abstract: This working paper examines the role of COVID-19 recovery grant programs and adaptive business strategies in shaping employment recovery across California counties between 2020 and 2025. Using publicly available administrative data sources, the study develops a county-level panel framework designed to evaluate the relationship between grant funding intensity and post-pandemic employment recovery. The analysis framework employs fixed-effects regression models to isolate the impact of policy interventions while controlling for structural and pre-pandemic economic conditions. This document presents the research design, theoretical motivation, and empirical strategy underlying the project. Expanded econometric results and replication materials are under preparation for peer-reviewed journal submission.
